| Wednesday, July 29, 2026| Trump & Netanyahu Huddle As Iran War Rages
---|---
5-minute read · 4 stories
Lead Story · Foreign PolicyTRUMP HOSTS NETANYAHU AS U.S. INTERCEPTS IRANIAN MISSILE BARRAGEWhat's Happening
* President Trump welcomed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to the White House on Tuesday for their first in-person meeting since the two launched the war against Iran.
* Hours before the meeting, U.S. Central Command said it intercepted Iranian ballistic missiles in what it called an **"attempted surprise attack"** on U.S. forces in the Middle East.
* A senior source traveling with Netanyahu said the leaders reaffirmed an "ironclad commitment to ensuring that Iran never has nuclear weapons," with Iran topping the agenda.

The Situation
* Trump said negotiations with Tehran should continue and that a deal would be his preference, while warning he would resume airstrikes if talks fail.
* The agenda also covered a framework for peace in Lebanon, expansion of the Abraham Accords, and Iran's reported buildout of the Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site.
* The visit followed reports of personal friction between the two leaders; Trump publicly called the meeting "productive."

The PerspectivePeace through strength is not a slogan when the missiles are real. Iran's attempted strike on our troops is a reminder that Tehran respects deterrence, not sympathy, and the administration is right to keep the door to diplomacy open while making clear the military option stays on the table. An Iran that never goes nuclear is a goal Americans across the spectrum should be able to rally behind.[Read the full story at Fox News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_NRx3TmKyUjNZ_2a-If6mrdkbgpnfUBw-HABG7inN_zYR6X0lIi0BXBRWQeXC8Yf8zDefFvnk2Bu8hFQaSva0NSnFZa2vfOmb0wO83L6zm0Db1gfkjGA8JWzmB8hom3bobFAGCyAzU5HLliUL9lLk53bbHSevCkCZbSAC3tyVpLJO9hcDpPeGqcO_BE2NLgs8EoyLkMBuD6SIxbFiU-6u_vYpz4c4qA2s2kVcQ3QR1NbWTVZANj2aFTTCLir_MdLKlEPNwu723E-0c9MybelZfI3pGAYR5aElsT18cjfcnnQzvySs2WQ8HWhQMMFtQ2AayRd7oN2Jn--j5U-atTCXN83moY6WilMCKMqJkT3ECIo36dH9Gfl0FV58fG1GtSkiA/4sq/JhZvr-ZsTPadP9I6440nvQ/h5/h001.q81SbOPNc9fOyzSjOdzZnuiDPuzYeQlDo5MG7wEmi00)

Election IntegrityTHUNE REBUFFS TRUMP'S PUSH TO CANCEL RECESS OVER SAVE ACTWhat's Happening
* Senate Majority Leader John Thune (R-SD) signaled he will not cancel the August recess to keep grinding on the House-passed SAVE America Act, calling the effort likely **futile** without the votes.
* Trump pressed Thune on Truth Social to keep the Senate in session until the bill passes or the filibuster is eliminated.
* Thune said a past White House lobbying push to nuke the filibuster drew "15 noes" from GOP senators: "the facts don't change."

The Situation
* The SAVE America Act would require proof of citizenship to register to vote and voter ID at the polls; the House passed it 218-213.
* The bill lacks the 60 votes to break a filibuster, and several Senate Republicans oppose changing the rules to force it through.
* The recess is set to begin Aug. 7, a stretch some senators view as critical campaign time before November.

The PerspectiveRequiring proof of citizenship and an ID to vote is common sense that large majorities of Americans support, and the House was right to pass it. But the votes in the Senate simply aren't there, and torching the filibuster to muscle it through would be a short-term win Republicans would regret the moment they're back in the minority. Thune's caution is frustrating, yet honest about the math.[Read the full story at Washington Examiner](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_F0KAElx4yVoiF03sTMUTyWFa1tWox1t_YE5rpY7L5b5Cf2TJgM_wG15QgDMmeJwOOvxbmzM8RyNmpgRD60NtaLPXIF7SjQKu8TVkQHyC9PaJWO0pLzfJ3CV-gd7mGPtg36PtIUCRVsZDFfFKo430l7mutmecsPUrX4iaT_Mzmhtvz7llu60n8HTPSXH2wP8jnSnyM-lhGYVVawK5X9gTH10piVsXhNM_XlYdl2vVMsOJDCPMEngKtIaDsWbHxc6elSiAIfymxtj-kDjzy5QFRFzLFX3T1BqTPhHZQe3PMl6W7IgkN8AsfgdYWrRGetfv376P0CDpQMb-J5qJzqXC6EGBFyUNlpAsO5LSZgjZf_DzQySg_T7ThGCfta42pBQaA/4sq/JhZvr-ZsTPadP9I6440nvQ/h6/h001.omWXWMQ0ZLGqvvB2MLB1LV6mMoM0JfPJ2uWkVEG4ihI)

The EconomyU.S. SETS NEW TARIFFS ON 60 TRADING PARTNERS AS TRUCE EXPIRESWhat's Happening
* The U.S. Trade Representative announced new tariffs on 60 trading partners, ranging from **10% to 12.5%** , as prior temporary duties expired.
* Canada, Mexico, India and the U.K. face the 10% rate; Taiwan and the European Union face up to 12.5%.
* The levies are being imposed under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974, after the Supreme Court struck down earlier tariffs issued under emergency powers.

The Situation
* The week opened with a framework deal setting EU tariffs at 15%, while talks with China in Sweden produced no deal ahead of an Aug. 12 truce deadline.
* The June jobs report showed the economy added just 57,000 jobs, with the unemployment rate at 4.2%.
* Wage growth trailed inflation for a third straight month, adding pressure on an administration betting on trade leverage.

The PerspectiveUsing tariffs as leverage to pry open markets and reshore critical supply chains is a legitimate strategy, and shifting to Section 301 shows the administration is willing to work within the law the Court laid down. The honest caveat: tariffs are a tax somebody pays, and with hiring soft and wages lagging inflation, the White House needs these deals to land quickly or families will feel the squeeze first.[Read the full story at NBC News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_KnXUR8YWdaXuMqU6tjDoFUB807ZLFT6S-CBSaoofvAeHaoVKrbTpzEmunojL3mPs3eEsNNl6SaJNTlbzwcGC7EPR8nljkzi6kgoXLuQWYOl3qyss8zzkivMmThoY_-EcG1WV8_TV0bfwoe2oajgGNZJVG24dOYcMnOW2IpT_Fa_lN5PpMQkWcpnwXYjZ8XKOl-mn7N6-hEEvr5B7hlqaQbqwqccLI1CRmvTRwpp7ECcsAe4MG0VW_8Pj-lrO-bt94TdstmKvPDpn2FXLGAhxozXGKLJR77L8BTBZrHWPwRK7y6_7ScdEf5FgyeVaqTQWf7Oo8obebF3P1zlfk9W3mY/4sq/JhZvr-ZsTPadP9I6440nvQ/h7/h001.QQ34WZKc-F03t3oARV4EU1IRrtMtq04Z41cx7jzV0aw)

The Nation MournsWASHINGTON BIDS FAREWELL TO SEN. LINDSEY GRAHAMWhat's Happening
* The late Sen. Lindsey Graham (R-SC), who died July 11 at age 71, was honored Tuesday with a ceremony in the Capitol Rotunda and a funeral service at Washington National Cathedral.
* President Trump and Vice President Vance were among those who spoke; an armed forces body bearer team carried his flag-draped casket in honor of his military service.
* A second service is planned for Wednesday in Graham's native South Carolina.

The Situation
* The preliminary cause of death was an aortic dissection tied to cardiovascular disease, following what his office called a "brief and sudden illness."
* Attendees included the Trump family, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, and foreign leaders Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Benjamin Netanyahu.
* Graham served in the Senate for more than three decades after time in the House and a long career in the Air Force Reserve.

The PerspectiveWhatever one thought of his politics, Lindsey Graham gave his life to public service and to a strong-defense vision of America's role in the world. That leaders from Israel and Ukraine crossed oceans to pay respects speaks to a seriousness of purpose worth honoring. Today is simply a day to be grateful for a life of service and to keep his family in our thoughts.[Read the full story at Fox News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_N8M2yF9-VjcaxkG0L0zQSWY7I1wkJhuNU53jUvWOHitHuHHF9eeVNyIBaa6CVRcAvTzmU-JmDR2SuwRoE8Pwle9XglJviCBLfq8MCOZuHZ-T2XI2fK3deQM7kyB4zcom7RIEYoZRcWJ9j384XbMj0duM_62AQmseCLTvc-PmyLraTCNOSAwa3iKvBQD7FkCqC6kgDsCfXQPFz2xK82dWs5C8go1PoaWszzTT28AFX6yqgvzcTNfJAagkOUy6z19oHQqTPTfLdkts2htCLsD41FyWAoIqC8z_yzGOmLGZzCxaaj0H0KDspm82c419FN-yDUzF95KBHwlyGKn5qj2WiA/4sq/JhZvr-ZsTPadP9I6440nvQ/h8/h001.L-Bkbvn0_rptll3hnii4BGLQSbziSz5akuR5r48Up0E)
| ⚡ The Bottom LineFrom a war room where missiles are being intercepted to a Senate floor where the votes just aren't there, today is a study in the gap between what leaders want and what reality allows — and Washington paused it all to bury one of its own. Strength abroad, honesty about the math at home, and respect for a life of service: that's the whole story, no spin required. That's just the truth.

Can I Spend $10K a Month? | You’ve saved $1.5 million. Now comes the real test. Can it produce $10,000 a month, or will that pace drain your portfolio? Most retirees do not get a clear answer until it is too late. The issue is not just how much you have. It is whether your portfolio was built to pay you, not just grow. That difference can determine whether your money lasts decades or starts breaking down early. Sequence of returns, taxes on withdrawals, healthcare costs, and whether the 4% rule still applies all play a role. Fiduciary advisors created a breakdown showing what drives sustainable income and why the same $1.5M can produce very different outcomes. If you have $1M or more invested, do not guess. | | Just The TruthYour No-BS NewsletterThe truth isn't conservative or liberal. It's just the truth. | Wednesday, July 29, 2026| Trump & Netanyahu Huddle As Iran War Rages ---|--- 5-minute read · 4 stories Lead Story · Foreign PolicyTRUMP HOSTS NETANYAHU AS U.S. INTERCEPTS IRANIAN MISSILE BARRAGEWhat's Happening President Trump welcomed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to the White House on Tuesday for their first in-person meeting since the two launched the war against Iran. Hours before the meeting, U.S. Central Command said it intercepted Iranian ballistic missiles in what it called an "attempted surprise attack" on U.S. forces in the Middle East. A senior source traveling with Netanyahu said the leaders reaffirmed an "ironclad commitment to ensuring that Iran never has nuclear weapons," with Iran topping the agenda. The Situation Trump said negotiations with Tehran should continue and that a deal would be his preference, while warning he would resume airstrikes if talks fail. The agenda also covered a framework for peace in Lebanon, expansion of the Abraham Accords, and Iran's reported buildout of the Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site. The visit followed reports of personal friction between the two leaders; Trump publicly called the meeting "productive." The PerspectivePeace through strength is not a slogan when the missiles are real. Iran's attempted strike on our troops is a reminder that Tehran respects deterrence, not sympathy, and the administration is right to keep the door to diplomacy open while making clear the military option stays on the table. An Iran that never goes nuclear is a goal Americans across the spectrum should be able to rally behind. Election IntegrityTHUNE REBUFFS TRUMP'S PUSH TO CANCEL RECESS OVER SAVE ACTWhat's Happening Senate Majority Leader John Thune (R-SD) signaled he will not cancel the August recess to keep grinding on the House-passed SAVE America Act, calling the effort likely futile without the votes. Trump pressed Thune on Truth Social to keep the Senate in session until the bill passes or the filibuster is eliminated. Thune said a past White House lobbying push to nuke the filibuster drew "15 noes" from GOP senators: "the facts don't change." The Situation The SAVE America Act would require proof of citizenship to register to vote and voter ID at the polls; the House passed it 218-213. The bill lacks the 60 votes to break a filibuster, and several Senate Republicans oppose changing the rules to force it through. The recess is set to begin Aug. 7, a stretch some senators view as critical campaign time before November. The PerspectiveRequiring proof of citizenship and an ID to vote is common sense that large majorities of Americans support, and the House was right to pass it. But the votes in the Senate simply aren't there, and torching the filibuster to muscle it through would be a short-term win Republicans would regret the moment they're back in the minority. Thune's caution is frustrating, yet honest about the math. The EconomyU.S. SETS NEW TARIFFS ON 60 TRADING PARTNERS AS TRUCE EXPIRESWhat's Happening The U.S. Trade Representative announced new tariffs on 60 trading partners, ranging from 10% to 12.5% , as prior temporary duties expired. Canada, Mexico, India and the U.K. face the 10% rate; Taiwan and the European Union face up to 12.5%. The levies are being imposed under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974, after the Supreme Court struck down earlier tariffs issued under emergency powers. The Situation The week opened with a framework deal setting EU tariffs at 15%, while talks with China in Sweden produced no deal ahead of an Aug. 12 truce deadline. The June jobs report showed the economy added just 57,000 jobs, with the unemployment rate at 4.2%. Wage growth trailed inflation for a third straight month, adding pressure on an administration betting on trade leverage. The PerspectiveUsing tariffs as leverage to pry open markets and reshore critical supply chains is a legitimate strategy, and shifting to Section 301 shows the administration is willing to work within the law the Court laid down. The honest caveat: tariffs are a tax somebody pays, and with hiring soft and wages lagging inflation, the White House needs these deals to land quickly or families will feel the squeeze first. The Nation MournsWASHINGTON BIDS FAREWELL TO SEN. LINDSEY GRAHAMWhat's Happening The late Sen. Lindsey Graham (R-SC), who died July 11 at age 71, was honored Tuesday with a ceremony in the Capitol Rotunda and a funeral service at Washington National Cathedral. President Trump and Vice President Vance were among those who spoke; an armed forces body bearer team carried his flag-draped casket in honor of his military service. A second service is planned for Wednesday in Graham's native South Carolina. The Situation The preliminary cause of death was an aortic dissection tied to cardiovascular disease, following what his office called a "brief and sudden illness." Attendees included the Trump family, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, and foreign leaders Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Benjamin Netanyahu. Graham served in the Senate for more than three decades after time in the House and a long career in the Air Force Reserve. The PerspectiveWhatever one thought of his politics, Lindsey Graham gave his life to public service and to a strong-defense vision of America's role in the world. That leaders from Israel and Ukraine crossed oceans to pay respects speaks to a seriousness of purpose worth honoring. Today is simply a day to be grateful for a life of service and to keep his family in our thoughts. | ⚡ The Bottom LineFrom a war room where missiles are being intercepted to a Senate floor where the votes just aren't there, today is a study in the gap between what leaders want and what reality allows — and Washington paused it all to bury one of its own. Strength abroad, honesty about the math at home, and respect for a life of service: that's the whole story, no spin required. That's just the truth. "The truth isn't conservative or liberal. California is fast-tracking a ballot measure that proponents call a "one-time" emergency levy on the ultra-rich--but don't be fooled, because if you live in the Golden State, you may soon get the bill too.

The commentary, published in 'The Tennessee Star' on June 4, 2026, warns that the so-called **[California Billionaire Tax Act](https://substack.com/redirect/bf16c751-03f8-4db7-9a72-699024a50c2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** (Initiative 25-0024) by Edward Ring, is not merely a tax on billionaires, despite its marketing. The measure, which supporters have gathered enough signatures to place on the November 2026 ballot, would impose a 5 percent tax on "covered assets." While its proponents advertise it as targeting roughly 200 Californians worth more than $1 billion--with a collective net worth exceeding $2 trillion--the commentary argues the framework is designed to ensnare ordinary residents as well.

The tax is positioned as a one-time emergency measure to raise an estimated $100 billion for state-funded healthcare, K-14 public education, and food assistance programs. Supporters, including labor unions like SEIU-UHW and the Teamsters, frame it as making billionaires pay their "fair share" to protect social services from federal funding cuts. However, critics note the bill defines "applicable individuals" broadly, including California residents and even part-year residents dating back to January 1, 2025--a residency provision critics liken to the Eagles' "[Hotel California](https://substack.com/redirect/08c5aa46-47b7-4d5f-85c6-26f0b1db0086?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)": you can check out, but you can never leave.

The Tennessee Star commentary highlights that if approved by voters, ordinary Californians could face a 5 percent tax on their own "covered assets." This raises the central argument: what starts as a tax on billionaires rarely stays there. The author suggests that once the state creates the administrative machinery to assess and tax wealth rather than income, the threshold will inevitably creep downward, putting middle-class homeowners, retirement savers, and small business owners in the crosshairs.

The piece also touches on the economic fallout already rippling through the state. Multiple billionaires, including tech entrepreneurs, have reportedly threatened to leave California or already relocated, taking their businesses, jobs, and tax revenue with them. Tax analysts note that tech wealth constitutes nearly 80 percent of California billionaire assets, making these individuals particularly mobile. The National Taxpayers Union has warned the proposal could actually lose the state money before it ever takes effect, as high earners flee to low-tax states like Texas, Florida, or Tennessee.

Additionally, the commentary raises legal red flags. The initiative attempts to build in alternative "apportionment mechanisms" and requests judicial reformation if its residency rules are struck down--a tacit admission by drafters that key provisions may be unconstitutional. The Tax Foundation and other policy experts have flagged serious constitutional questions about a state's ability to tax former residents or out-of-state assets.

The article's core message is a familiar conservative warning: Wealth taxes always expand beyond their original targets. What Sacramento sells as a one-time emergency levy on 200 plutocrats is, in reality, a precedent-setting wealth tax that could eventually hit anyone with a home, a 401(k), or a family business. California voters, the author concludes, should look carefully at who is really being taxed--because once government gains the power to tax wealth, everyone becomes a potential "covered asset." Welcome to the hotel Washington state...[owned by government](https://substack.com/redirect/09289709-1964-44c1-bef9-270af22b88bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

You may have read the news about Pastor Ezra Jin Mingri's persecution for running a Christian church in China and his eventual release to be reunited with his family.

A short excerpt from an [Associated Press story](http://links.johnkasich.com/s/c/UMVF1HN4kJtq9XsJHkJ-I7xMtd88StnjLe1NAQODhbhUUTd5vH_wReINUYC4fHQ6M5ULQPEzPV0AKj5htvgc8WvNiUsWCVBA3ki4HApReTn5OB5_dH31d9sSIBASCTYNw5e5SpHOawBKOR9Gwomeixk2GV608MdDoOL3JvBYAyaWtHQvJ9JNvA4Ni3SPTincB_oMfHZw674XNBLRU9Cxi7bJN1E1f3-ols6Y4vHduELvIF4qg8ractpKNoaa3R8FdmUNoeL-pZJVyHy81vzX2VptDAKwrKU6hsFJOyGcPAWXmI-a9hlF72MHjZngsQ3vF4zvrDtI9-859X-Fy-ZxCjdweGcipNXW4w07AjJU4OogHThWWVpLQS9pgdk6Y7b-SOyouMS2p5qcE0OW52TQOPckfn9gR5NiFwXhUszUuucPja68cS8waItV0iojU55KjLCZid0GahH9rzOyLtH0xGh3JSXfLX48axtRoMXnm4-wahx9ltIiJ7Hdk-i7iv37k36mL3JIMf0VAhYskLCSP0Nm_679M5ux9n64xM6Gye-Vq_sE3g/RiNBzpbMo1J_aIIk3D8yCDf9wZt5PcZF/23):
_"Jin founded Zion Church in 2007, and it grew into one of the most influential independent congregations in China. They are different from officially sanctioned places of worship, which accept Communist Party rule._

_In 2018, authorities in Beijing shut down the church’s physical sanctuary after the congregation refused to install surveillance cameras. Jin sent his family to the U.S. but stayed behind to keep developing the church, which met in small groups and gained a strong online following during the COVID-19 pandemic. In October 2025, Jin and other church leaders were detained in another crackdown."_ He was not released until July 2026.

Last week, on my SiriusXM show, I had the opportunity to speak with Pastor Jin's daughter, Grace Jin Drexel, who is a passionate advocate for the ability of Christians to worship without persecution. You can learn more about her work at [LukeAlliance.org.](http://links.johnkasich.com/s/c/P3wiSXTcnyXKzkXSHV7Xsa3fp5FiwFYmDANoiCTT8fS7jd-s8-dMQBwbKOp9LBnyVwnWxdmSGjq0wHtsMDD1gXYKVPpVtnv7A15WF-fam_zyYOv5k3gMYw_knhtVqks1sb1gJHjnOiHY7hWspdRrrqcEcIAdce2fadG4003YQjDHnC2q1qldW4gHYRelBIk9mjTkfxvEXe37vc0qbNPdtClHOXEdE4H0vuCh0QQUrLkNF8drljuMaafyZ7Qlm4lKGl01rpOLPxsuN-nWaxOE1vlFs-biQICSmV6GgNFgWocppWHcWWomu3idXGjO7h_Ukm_UQYxS1lOls12Axi3GYJp7MroIq7judetb6vW7xFz1R70/KUu7_q_XclI0O7hlujb6fssc0GIqAnJt/23) **You can listen to a clip below or see instructions about how you can listen to the entire episode!****** Thank you for your ongoing interest and support!

## Hello Peter,
---
America’s food supply is about more than what’s on our dinner tables, it’s about our national security, our farmers, and the future of our families. Recently, _Moms for America President Kimberly Fletcher_ published a powerful op-ed in the Washington Examiner explaining why the proposed Save Our Bacon Act raises serious concerns. It benefits foreign-owned agricultural interests and weakens states’ ability to set food production standards, such as those that reduce toxins and chemicals, and ensure more humane treatment of animals. We encourage you to read Kim’s op-ed to learn more about what’s at stake. At Moms for America Action, we believe food security is national security. That’s why we’re launching a long-term national campaign to educate families and advocate for policies that keep America’s food supply in American hands and reduce foreign influence over our agricultural system, including by opposing the so-called _“Save Our Bacon” Act._ **Today, we need your help.** Please take a few minutes to contact your U.S. Senators and ask them to oppose including the Save Our Bacon Act, or similar language, in the Farm Bill.
👉 Contact your Senator [**_CLICK HERE_**](https://mc4s5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsDg0irXZSgdATNt61kLNh/zyQXAn4FJIaZ)
**Sample Message to Congress.**
Dear Senator, As one of your constituents, I respectfully urge you to oppose including the so-called Save Our Bacon Act or similar language in the Farm Bill. America’s food supply is a matter of national security. Congress should prioritize American farmers, protect state authority, and ensure our food system remains secure and independent from growing foreign influence. Please stand with American families and oppose policies that could further expand the influence of foreign-owned corporations over America’s food supply. Thank you for your service and for representing our community. Sincerely, [Your Name][City, State]

Over the coming months, Moms for America Action will continue educating families, engaging lawmakers, and advocating for policies that protect America’s food supply from foreign influence. We hope you’ll stand with us every step of the way. Together, we can keep America’s food supply secure, for our families, our farmers, and future generations.

subject: Nancy Mannion for Congress - Weekly Update

body:
| | | | |
---
## **News from the Campaign Trail**

**Conversations, Community and Democracy**
Thank you to everyone who joined us for coffee and conversation at Levengoods in downtown Lancaster on Friday morning. It was a wonderful chance to reconnect with old friends and meet new neighbors. I’m grateful to Liam and the Levengoods team for hosting us, and to volunteers Christina and Stephanie for organizing and supporting the event.
| | |
---|---|---
| |
| |
| |
| |
| Established in 1765, the York State Fair is known as America’s oldest state fair, and democracy was on full display thanks to the Democratic Party of York County. York County candidates will appear throughout the fair, which runs July 24–August 2. I was there Saturday evening to greet the public, and we enjoyed conversations with enthusiastic constituents from York, Lancaster, and beyond.
---
| | |
---|---|---
| |
| |
| |
| |
| Another highlight last week was speaking to the more than sixty attendees of the “Foundations of Democracy” group at Willow Valley, where we discussed upcoming Medicare changes resulting from the “One Big Beautiful Bill” passed last year.
---
| | |
---|---|---
| |
| |
| |
| |
| ✉️ Enjoying These Campaign Updates? Help us grow our community by forwarding this email to friends, family, and neighbors. **Was this email forwarded to you?** Sign up to receive Nancy's campaign updates directly in your inbox. | [ Sign Up for Campaign Updates → ](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsDg0dq0ZHdOMtph7VT17J/6GnZngMbM63K)
---
| | | **Women’s Leadership and Labor Stand with Nancy**
I’m honored to be endorsed by the [National Women’s Political Caucus](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsE8LM2QxdjJX9tWVKRkpN/hpXwAuvuOd3u), founded in 1971 to support women seeking elected and appointed office. I will always stand up for workers’ right to organize through unions, and I’m proud to have also earned the endorsement of the South Central PA UAW Council.
---
| | |
---
| | | | **97 Days to Organize, Volunteer and Win!**
As the campaign enters its final stretch, I’ll continue connecting with communities across the district at town halls, parades, fairs, and coffee conversations at local businesses. Check my website for updates on where I’ll be next.As we prepare for our fall Get Out The Vote effort, my campaign is working with the Governor’s Coordinated Campaign on canvassing and phone banking, while also partnering with Democratic State House and Senate candidates on outreach. Stay tuned for canvassing launch dates. We’re building an army of volunteers to get out the vote, and we need you! [Sign up here to join our efforts](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsEag4ErLzpEhPxLt9QUXR/oVzqOVWbGZbW).

---
**Get Your Yard Sign Today!**
Get ahead of the fall rush and order yours now. [Click here](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsF30mRHkLv9rg1BGyPEFV/Aqe0UEaNwmVQ) to reserve one now and a volunteer will deliver one to you or coordinate a pick-up.
| | |
---|---|---
| |
| |
| |
| |
|
---
**Grassroots Power vs. PAC Money**
A recent LNP LancasterOnline article reported on Lloyd Smucker’s campaign finances, noting that he has raised more than $800,000 from business-related PACs since the start of the two-year 2026 campaign cycle. In contrast, we are a grassroots-powered campaign and I’m grateful for the outpouring of support I received in response to the article. Your donations help fund advertising, polling, handouts, and yard signs to ensure voters’ voices will be heard when I am your Congresswoman. **[Donate here](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsFVLUdi8i151w50enNxxZ/ja1Hm38RmtFr)** to **help me fire Lloyd Smucker on November 3rd!**
| | |
### **Want to meet or support Nancy?**
---

## **Anthony Fauci knew about COVID in December and made false claims about its origin**
Fauci repeatedly claimed that COVID-19 likely mutated in a marketplace, and that the first contraction of the disease was from someone eating a bat or armadillo. In his diary, he explicitly contradicts himself:
> "It now appears using epi data and genomic data that the first infection was in early December and was not connected to the market. ... Remember, early on the Chinese were saying that there is no human to human transmission and all the original 27 cases were from the market. Now we know the market was not the source, it was the amplifier. Having said that, somewhere the virus jumped from animals to humans."

Peter,

When I stepped into this race, I didn’t just enter politics—I stepped into a war.

**_A war against the lies, the labels, the machine that tells people like me to sit down and shut up._ ** I knew the media would lie. I knew the elites—on both sides—would do their best to shut me up, shut me down, and shut me out.

Because here’s the truth: I am everything they fear.

A free-thinking Black man who won’t kneel. A Republican who doesn’t beg for approval. A fighter who answers to **God, Country, and Truth** —not party bosses or corporate donors.

That’s why they’ve gone scorched earth. They’ve smeared my name. Mocked my faith. Attacked my mental health. Why? Because _**I don’t fit their box—and I never will.**_

If I win, the system cracks. The ruling class panics. The elites lose their grip. That’s why they’ll spend millions to stop one man—**me** —from standing with **YOU**.

| [ **CRACK THE SYSTEM** ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=20e68d8a29b4479e9eeb57a453dc6bec&_e=r4XUo2plEsDYzZzAMg_lmCpvbXTdFEf09yx4WQprztZcUx33G5GSdT4ZCsWRtYEqie_L1eztacATqoH6lp-veVtQNWDNzEitRK18kJaC_op1O_8F1zBQCNpaW45QSr0A1qJ5id4-N3TnfFEBgpY6Z4ba3kO40LI2AP7VBm63RxVzZ6JIH2o0b_fS9HRo2OJize1D2afT2vmaEIEb9y778QIpAwCBajN9kNvlfZ0iHRODb8mgOSiPZMavEEvc7SKxZFHCy9Tu4LpkY-wgITVEIqxaqNXl3vtyvgDlDG_6xR0UtHe7-QIBV__3lRIpYS13cf7RxVfOcAU-TAkyq0JKrnXfwTR5_BAYCwN1GZtdBJwvfVRcDHY1GmQWfLQ4XKLZJhRhM3jHeKyI7bHSaa2BvGpDxXuH4mEtNkhpPrZAZr_A320JzJAZH3aUk6a6JIm8zGWxrGrVAJuCzmmkBQBYSnMO-FHvDAk3bAsHhf6g3DNS0qbSS_sV1Od3RqjE0anyJsPE1RL5UmU7v3pEGge9BefuoNIfWmFnokCkBiQ2FVrejqhKmoS0Yaf8nx4djTlS)

It’ll show the whole country that Minnesota is ready for real change, not polished lies. And that scares them more than anything.

**[But I can’t win this fight alone.](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=20e68d8a29b4479e9eeb57a453dc6bec&_e=r4XUo2plEsDYzZzAMg_lmCpvbXTdFEf09yx4WQprztZcUx33G5GSdT4ZCsWRtYEqie_L1eztacATqoH6lp-veVtQNWDNzEitRK18kJaC_op1O_8F1zBQCNpaW45QSr0A1qJ5id4-N3TnfFEBgpY6Z4ba3kO40LI2AP7VBm63RxVzZ6JIH2o0b_fS9HRo2OJitEX4idPzijojNssSU5wEt1XzkiOLQxMSX3KecppywRboMpz48t4Qn4IBMGdyI2a95gzgEnIvMy-InY_joa7CrStKLt5rlTLlKLYFr71GaVIOgigmxy02CUvrVsc-IH3wZlr93Oh-Cl6AhHigWYfyHQAsm17_V0Qa53ct3MWQHtqACw9LoF1tYjPZglbcg3gTknJwTB9outQcJRvXmQgeChTJuS8RoGY9lsXCo4-kwGqung5cRnD7q8fzPlYmUJKMDZkDX5k8a8GRWLEFMD-LHF_MVThjlEQQQhlD32RaByU59LIAwkByM1MERCFjyrCfGX0fP38TOuZgQSLqAbpEK_Rcyye8yOPK9XFlB9bHEBz6o8UdZDAJvxw_82iV5NoM)** I’m out here every day—town to town, shaking hands, speaking truth—and I need your help to keep going. This is it. This is our chance.

[**If just 1,000 patriots chip in $10 tonight, we can light the fuse and flip this race on its head. Will you be one of them?**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=20e68d8a29b4479e9eeb57a453dc6bec&_e=r4XUo2plEsDYzZzAMg_lmCpvbXTdFEf09yx4WQprztZcUx33G5GSdT4ZCsWRtYEqie_L1eztacATqoH6lp-veVtQNWDNzEitRK18kJaC_op1O_8F1zBQCNpaW45QSr0A1qJ5id4-N3TnfFEBgpY6Z4ba3kO40LI2AP7VBm63RxVzZ6JIH2o0b_fS9HRo2OJiqxPSowFjpSDlLiQBekgcd2p4NAOyUg-Z75zq9U_Lge2WfTDoKC7tU3812fB6lJlBRvQ0Ak9_f3MGVdHBBZgVGryO_Rnv0rwDo1bOHLbm6DBB8jNEpo6WqEITP1M1jSnGZcaJcW6cNeK1ODwl8q2xWFEpKpF2co6clBbG8Mp6_u8u4WLOjqEXgXXMh-PoC52KU9_uMt8-zeVmgeLaAo-4I5HfhVleGVvhqAF3uKqdMd7jHH7cfW_eqvfym6gk2jnuAMCsrHuHJRtVOjnGvWFa72r6myDEBlm2DGziu2YVU6xKSG1ssN-W3qqzv3kTyArp9db8cwOKk3LMfPOXaRoSbXQASKRXQwqNPBV2T0NXtfid3md-GQUetMs8JsV-Orr5) This isn’t Left vs. Right. This is the people vs. the machine. And I’m not here to play nice—I’m here to burn the lies down and build something real.

And I promise you this: I will never bow to the machine. Not now. Not ever.

Let’s make history. Let’s win this.

Royce Alexander White

Meet Royce White:

**Born and raised in the Twin Cities, Royce White was the son of a single mother and started playing sports at the age of 5 years old. Living in various neighborhoods growing up, much of his family remained in the Rondo community, where he spent much of his time and received schooling. White excelled at basketball and recieved a scholarship to play basketball at the University of Minnesota, and later transferred to Iowa State. He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards.

_After being selected 16th overall by The Houston Rockets in the NBA draft, White began to voice concerns about the NBA’s collective bargaining agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist. Eventually, his concerns became a public dispute between White and the NBA. This resulted in White demanding that the NBA, as a representative of the global corporate community, take up the responsibility of spearheading the mental health conversation – not just posturing through press statements, but through policy._

Royce then went on to win two championships in Canada before moving over to play Big 3 Basketball. White appeared at a game in a t-shirt that read “Free The Uyghurs.” After a game-winning basket, White did a post-game interview on CBS, where he called for 2 Million Uyghurs to be freed and released from concentration camps. As the season went on, White would touch on taboo topics such as Gain of Function Research, The Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Larry Hoover, Jeff Fort, Muammar Gaddafi, The Great Reset, Ivermectin, Me Too, etc.

Now, Royce White is running for Senate in Minnesota to take down the Radical Left. Republicans have not seen recent success in Minnesota, but Royce's campaign is different: a grassroots movement that's sick of the Radical Agenda pushed by Far Left Democrats Tina Smith and Ilhan Omar. Royce needs your help to pull off a fourth quarter comeback victory and FLIP Minnesota Red for Republicans.

| | | **[Tell Republicans:"Stop Harassing Fauci, and Start Holding RFK Jr Accountable](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te6843ac9-8acd-4c2a-9df1-8323ae2fc7c4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**[**"**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8dd3f94e-9d8d-43fd-942f-0c5c1f5aebd2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Dr. Anthony Fauci spent more than half a century using science to protect Americans from infectious diseases. People made dangerous medical decisions because they believed this garbage.

**But Republicans are treating Fauci like the criminal.** And Trump's war on science continues. He put RFK Jr., one of America's most notorious anti-vaccine activists, in charge of public health. And surprise, surprise: measles is roaring back.

More than 2,300 cases have already been confirmed this year. Children are getting sick from a disease America essentially eliminated more than 25 years ago.

Republicans are persecuting the scientist while empowering the conspiracy theorists.

Peter, see that little girl in the photo? That's me!

I must've been about eight or nine years old. I don't mean to brag, but I was a pretty good roller skater... and clearly I thought those tube socks were the height of fashion.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136213023/636723082/-2016015222?refcode=em26_260729_EOM3_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260729_EOM3_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=65edaaf8-598b-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NWVkYWFmOC01OThiLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=L9DmQMK7PfnwvZCBuAc958DR1Dpzj0p13AkCAEPDKA8=)
That's the trailer where we lived. It wasn't fancy, but it was the home where my parents poured all their love and hard work into giving us a good childhood.

Back then, I don't remember hearing much about politics. Washington felt a million miles away. Our world was Ford trucks, Johnny Cash, and spending Friday nights with a bucket of Kentucky Fried Chicken while laughing at The Dukes of Hazzard. Life was simple, and as a kid, I assumed it would always stay that way.

Then my dad got sick. Overnight, everything changed. **His health insurance was canceled, and my family lost nearly everything trying to save him.** I realized that sometimes, even if you do everything right, even if you're the hardest-working man on the construction site, **circumstances beyond your control can knock you down.**

I was able to keep moving forward because people before me had built a country that didn't leave families completely on their own. Public education gave me opportunities I never imagined. Social Security and Medicare helped provide a foundation when my family needed it most. Combined with a lot of hard work, I was able to build a life that little girl in the picture never could have dreamed of.

**I want every family in Iowa to have the same chance I had.** I want parents to know that one illness won't erase everything they've worked for. I want every child to have the opportunity to dream big and then build the life they want.

I believe in an economy that rewards hard work, but I also believe that when life knocks someone down, we should help them get back on their feet, rather than turning our backs.

**[That's the Iowa I'm fighting for every single day, and I hope I can keep counting on your support in this race. Will you make a donation to my campaign's $15,000 end-of-month goal? Any donation will help me keep up the work>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136213025/636723084/-2016015222?refcode=em26_260729_EOM3_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260729_EOM3_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=65edaaf8-598b-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NWVkYWFmOC01OThiLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=L9DmQMK7PfnwvZCBuAc958DR1Dpzj0p13AkCAEPDKA8=)**

Thank you,

clean_body: | = = Peter, see that little girl in the photo? That's me! I must've been about eight or nine years old. I don't mean to brag, but I was a pretty good roller skater... and clearly I thought those tube socks were the height of fashion. = That's the trailer where we lived. It wasn't fancy, but it was the home where my parents poured all their love and hard work into giving us a good childhood. Back then, I don't remember hearing much about politics. Washington felt a million miles away. Our world was Ford trucks, Johnny Cash, and spending Friday nights with a bucket of Kentucky Fried Chicken while laughing at The Dukes of Hazzard. Life was simple, and as a kid, I assumed it would always stay that way. Then my dad got sick. Overnight, everything changed. His health insurance was canceled, and my family lost nearly everything trying to save him. I realized that sometimes, even if you do everything right, even if you're the hardest-working man on the construction site, circumstances beyond your control can knock you down. I was able to keep moving forward because people before me had built a country that didn't leave families completely on their own. Public education gave me opportunities I never imagined. Social Security and Medicare helped provide a foundation when my family needed it most. Combined with a lot of hard work, I was able to build a life that little girl in the picture never could have dreamed of. I want every family in Iowa to have the same chance I had. I want parents to know that one illness won't erase everything they've worked for. I want every child to have the opportunity to dream big and then build the life they want. I believe in an economy that rewards hard work, but I also believe that when life knocks someone down, we should help them get back on their feet, rather than turning our backs. = Thank you, Christina Christina Bohannan is a mom, law professor, engineer and former state representative. A call for your support, Volunteer opportunities, Upcoming Events, and more. | | | [](https://p9t2.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6a6a151c1b3ad47109933bc0&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amandabellforcongress.org%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D6a5f8b482593546fe5cc2141%26ss_email_id%3D6a6a151c1b3ad47109933bc0%26ss_campaign_name%3DHelp%2Bfor%2Bthe%2BFox%2BCities%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-07-29T14%253A59%253A17Z&w=68e039f025c0f2594aa3b682&c=b_6a5f8b482593546fe5cc2141&l=en-US&s=yEeftn_NqsTEknBw286dTkYLklQ%3D)
---
| |
---
07.28.26 Newsletter
---
## Amanda Bell for Congress
---
|
---
#### Urgent Updates:
By Amanda Bell I cannot begin to express the heartbreak I have for the people who have lost everything from the tornadoes in the Fox Valley area. We spent all day Friday, talking to people on Doty Island, and yesterday it was destroyed. Families who have lived there for generations, have lost everything and I cannot fathom their losses. If you need help with personal goods, food, pet items or anything else, please reach out to 211, The United Way, and Community Foundation for the Fox Valley Region. All are providing support and resources for families affected. The Winnebago County Public Health Services are also fielding calls for support. And of course - if you need support, please reach out to us at admin@amandabellforcongress.org and we’ll help you get connected. If you have donations of non-perishable foods, household items, personal care, products, pet products or clothing you can donate them at the following places:
* Barlow Planetarium – Collecting donations: 1478 Midway Road, Menasha - collecting bottled water, emergency supplies, and other donations
* Outagamie Dems Office - collecting donations of non-perishable food, hygiene items, formula, diapers, and bottled water. Collected at 516 W. College Ave. Appleton, WI 54911
* Christ the Rock Menasha: Collecting donations for the CTR Food Pantry. Use the West Doors (furthest to your left as you face the building)
* Calvary Bible Church – collecting donations (no frozen or refrigerated food)
* 1450 Oakridge Drive, Neenah
* Mill City Church in Neenah is bringing in Convoy of Hope: https://convoyofhope.org/disaster-relief/severe-wisconsin-tornado-hits-rapidly-convoy-brings-help-hope/
* Alliance Church in Appleton is bringing Samaritans Purse: https://www.spvolunteer.org/project-response/810
* Fox Valley Humane Association - Donations of dog and cat food, cat litter, and other pet supplies. Monetary donations to help cover care costs. Become a temporary foster for victims of the storms. https://www.foxvalleypets.org/get-involved/donate/
* Boys and Girls Club is offering free child care for affected families.

If you are able to volunteer with cleanup that coordination is occurring through the fox cities:
* https://getconnected.volunteerfoxcities.org/need/index?s=1&need_init_id=15784&drm=1
* Join our signal group where we’re working across multiple districts to support those who need us here: https://signal.group/#CjQKIP69BbWoTN_NTB45ey-a6SgQxiAjG7qQfj7fySk5X-WOEhD8XyfAlm7W3azCD-ffN8fB

If you can’t volunteer or donate items, The United Way and Community Foundations as well as local church organizations are taking donations to help affected families. **Above all else:** Please make sure you’re caring for yourself. The impacts of this devastation are not only physical, but also emotional. If you are feeling distressed, please contact 988. You do not have to go through this alone. You are cared for. Your determined candidate, Amanda Bell Candidate, Wisconsin’s 6th Congressional District
---
|
---
---
|
---
#### Early voting for this primary is open!
Don’t wait till election day when you can go to your precinct clerk and vote right now. Reach out to your clerk for more information. Find details here: https://myvote.wi.gov/en-us/My-Municipal-Clerk Remember this is a closed primary so you must choose a party to and only vote in primaries for that party. If you cross the ballot to vote in another primary your ballot will not be counted. Don’t forget Amanda is running on the Democratic ticket and don’t forget to vote for Amanda Bell for the 6th Congressional District Congressional seat!
---
|
---
#### Upcoming Events
Amanda will be at these events in the coming week. Please see the events page for up-to-date appearances and more information! July 29 - A group of volunteers from my campaign are going up to help the victims of the tornados, we’re bringing chainsaws, donation items, and our services to help clear debris, and more. July 30th @ 4 PM - 6PM - Fond Du Lac Library - A Volunteer led meeting to discuss ideas and how you can help for these last two weeks before the primary and beyond. July 30 @ 6:30PM Virtual Listening & Problem Solving Session: Tune in here: https://meet.google.com/veq-npxs-fwh Or dial: ‪(US) +1 510-358-8037‬ PIN: ‪505 234 691‬# July 31 @ 5:30 PM Coloma Listening Session, 155 N Front St Coloma, WI Aug 1 @ 11 AM Cambria Parade - Cambria, WI Aug 2 - 8th Canvassing across the district Aug 8 @ 10 AM Susie the Duck Parade Aug 9 @ 10 AM Kiel Parade & Picnic Aug 10 @ Virtual Listening & Problem Solving Session - Tune in here: Video call link: [https://meet.google.com/imp-jwai-vkw](https://p9t2.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6a6a151c1b3ad47109933bc0&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmeet.google.com%2Fimp-jwai-vkw&w=68e039f025c0f2594aa3b682&c=b_6a5f8b482593546fe5cc2141&l=en-US&s=eGGeXNTUV4c-Rgd5dLxGVTnhGww%3D) Or dial: ‪(US) +1 443-914-3041‬ PIN: ‪386 857 587‬#
#### Aug 11th:
#### VOTE FOR AMANDA IN THE PRIMARY
Find your polling place and hours here: https://myvote.wi.gov/en-us/find-my-polling-place Check Facebook, YouTube, and TikTok throughout the day to tune in Live and chat as we work on getting people out to the polls to Goat the Vote! For more information on any of these events email admin@amandabellforcongress.org
---
|
---
### Lets talk about the issues
Last week Amanda participated in a debate where she shared her thoughts and plans on multiple topics and issues. She has been listening to her neighbors across the district, across the aisles and there are so many issues that we’re all facing. Amanda believes that we can find common ground in our values without compromising our integrity or ethics. She feels strongly that our communities need someone willing to stand up and fight for them. We the people make this country and she’s ready to represent everyone. Her entire career she’s been a public servant, not a politician and she’s had to work with congress through out her career, writing policy and ensuring a strict adherence to budgets and counting every penny of your money. If you’re ready for a representative who actually represents you, Vote for her August 11th. Watch last week’s debate here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ybDAH84XNo&list=PLrsHUa0N7Mbcb_XcSsvQVAmcF3hAZsOHD

| | | | | |
# This Week with Team Berge
---
| |
Hi Team Berge,
We are officially in the final two weeks before the August 11 primary, and we are so grateful for everything you are doing to support Emily and this campaign.
Every door you knock, call you make, event you attend, and conversation you have helps us reach more voters across Wisconsin’s 3rd Congressional District.
---
| |
# Featured Events
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

Join us this Thursday at The Plus in Eau Claire for Boogie with Berge!
Come enjoy live music, meet other supporters, and spend the evening with Emily and the campaign. We want to have a great turnout as we head into the final stretch before the primary, so please RSVP and invite a friend to join you.
We also have volunteer opportunities available for anyone who can help us make the evening a success!
---
| [RSVP to Boogie with Berge!](https://us.list-manage.com/ueEjMl5e131?e=1362dd258a&c2id=d51b517ba2e5c823fe0a3e4f0e8330f1)
---
|
---
| |

Join Emily Berge and Chris Porterfield at SHIFT Coffee on Tuesday, August 4, for a relaxed evening of music, community, and conversation. This event is completely free, and no RSVP is needed. Just stop by, bring a friend, and enjoy the evening with us!

# [The Electoral-Industrial Complex (I Reject)](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3260111&post_id=208845167&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA4ODQ1MTY3LCJpYXQiOjE3ODUzMzc0MTUsImV4cCI6MTc4NzkyOTQxNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTMyNjAxMTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.FozE17-Zefc_hagiDv4GAIInTRvLiKrvvDiKpkAcz4M)
### I refuse to turn my supporters or my soul into fodder for the political machine.
| | [Melissa Chaudhry](https://substack.com/@melissa4congress)

Every election cycle, candidates are told the same thing: **raise more money.**
Raise money to prove you are "serious." Raise money to prove you are "viable." Raise money to attract attention from institutions that will not take you seriously until you have raised enough money to pay the institutions, "con-men" aka consultants, platforms, vendors, and advertisers that determine who gets taken seriously.
(And if you dare to run without paying the piper, a certain form of shark will attack your character and sabotage, malign, accuse and undermine your candidacy. Ask me how I know.)
**The electoral-industrial complex is a machine that repeatedly cites its own appetite as evidence of necessity.**
Now sure, campaigns do require money. Printing costs money. Travel costs money. Filing reports, communicating with voters, organizing volunteers, maintaining secure technology, producing materials, and reaching a large congressional district _all cost money._ I am sincerely grateful to every person who has entrusted this campaign with a contribution, and I am asking those who can afford to help to be among them.
**But money is supposed to be a tool used in service of democracy.**
_Increasingly, American "democracy" is treated as a tool used to generate money._
Around every candidate now sits an enormous electoral-industrial complex: consultants, fundraisers, polling firms, print shops, advertising companies, data brokers, texting vendors, email platforms, compliance vendors, voter-file companies, opposition researchers, media buyers, list sellers, strategists, and layer upon layer of middlemen. Some provide legitimate expertise and valuable work. Others manufacture dependency, sell candidates solutions to problems their own industry helped create, collect their overblown fees, and remain well compensated whether or not the candidate wins, the movement grows, or the public becomes any more empowered.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3260111&post_id=208845167&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA4ODQ1MTY3LCJpYXQiOjE3ODUzMzc0MTUsImV4cCI6MTc4NzkyOTQxNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTMyNjAxMTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.FozE17-Zefc_hagiDv4GAIInTRvLiKrvvDiKpkAcz4M)
**Political consulting is one of the few industries in which the people selling the cure may also have defined the disease.**
The result is a closed loop. Candidates are told they must raise enormous sums to demonstrate their "viability." They must then spend those sums on the professional ecosystem _that decides who appears viable_. Fundraising becomes evidence of strength... because the people who live on campaign money _say_ that fundraising is evidence of strength. The logic is insane.
**This circular logic has become so normalized that candidates announce fundraising totals as though the money itself were the public good they produced.**
But money raised is not the same as _trust earned_. Money spent is not the same as _democracy strengthened_. Payroll is not _public service_. Advertising is not _organizing_. Name recognition is not wisdom, integrity, courage, competence, or constitutional understanding.
In my congressional race, another candidate has made the amount she has raised a central proof of her political strength. According to her campaign's FEC reporting, she raised approximately $609,000 and spent approximately $585,000 between April 2025 and June 2026. She ended that reporting period with about $24,000 in cash and nearly $20,000 in reported debt.
Those numbers establish that her campaign can raise and consume a great deal of money. Clearly. They do not, by themselves, answer the question that matters:
**What durable democratic capacity existed afterward that did not exist before?**
_What did the spending leave behind?_
Did it give people a deeper understanding of their government and their constitutional rights? Did it develop local leaders who will remain active after Election Day? Did it build independent civic institutions? Did it make communities less vulnerable to manipulation, surveillance, fear, and political abandonment? Did it leave voters with greater power over the decisions affecting their lives?
_Or did most of the activity exist only as long as the money continued moving?_
This is not a complaint that campaigns spend money. **It is a demand that we stop mistaking financial throughput for democratic achievement.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9tZWxpc3NhNGNvbmdyZXNzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.Hv8PQ829FuIBe-GiTofIUYmRlU6fh6okShscgtyAdis?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=208845167)
The electoral-industrial complex does not merely monetize elections. **It monetizes democratic helplessness.** It needs citizens to believe that every election is existential, but that their role is confined to donating, clicking, canvassing from an _strictly_ approved script, choosing among _institutionally filtered_ candidates, and waiting for political professionals to save them.
**It needs people frightened enough to give, but not empowered enough to reorganize power.**
That is why so much political fundraising is built around artificial emergencies, invented deadlines, catastrophic subject lines, and messages implying that democracy will collapse at midnight unless you send $17 immediately. The next morning brings another emergency, another deadline, another request and another warning that everything will be lost.
**When failure produces more fundraising, failure is no longer a threat to the institutions that are supposed to be responsible for winning.** There is no real incentive to change behavior - to truly _try_ to win, to learn from mistakes, to evolve strategies, to face humility, to improve... \- if failure still provides economic value.
A party loses an election, and the consultants remain. A campaign burns through millions of dollars, loses, and its well-paid strategists simply move to the next campaign. Institutions repeatedly misunderstand the public, suppress strong grassroots candidates, defend unpopular incumbents, and communicate in language that ordinary people no longer trust. Then they cite the consequences of their own failures as proof that we must send them more money.
**It 's ludicrous.**
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3260111&post_id=208845167&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA4ODQ1MTY3LCJpYXQiOjE3ODUzMzc0MTUsImV4cCI6MTc4NzkyOTQxNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTMyNjAxMTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.FozE17-Zefc_hagiDv4GAIInTRvLiKrvvDiKpkAcz4M)
The public is told that it is the customer. Too often, the public is the product.
Our money is harvested. Our fear is cultivated. Our attention is captured. Our behavior is scored. Our contact information is copied across databases and routed through companies most of us have never heard of, used for our own manipulation, and who knows what other purposes. Our names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, donation histories, interests, political views, and engagement patterns become campaign assets to be analyzed, traded, transferred, targeted, retained, and bought and sold to whoever can pay. **I know.**
The extraction is not only financial. It is informational.
I know what it feels like to donate to one campaign I believe in and suddenly find myself on fifteen other mailing lists I never joined. I do not like it. I do not believe you like it either. **I will not do that to you.**
We carefully assess vendors, platforms, and service providers for data privacy practices. If they expose your information, or violate our trust, they're out. You won't see the normal set of tools and platforms associated with us. That's very deliberate, and it's because we respect you.
I do not want our supporters' relationship with this campaign automatically hijacked into a relationship with an expansive partisan fundraising ecosystem. I wanted a platform that allowed us to maintain greater independence and exercise more control over how supporter information is handled. Why? Because we respect you.
No technological platform eliminates every risk, and federal campaigns must collect and report certain contributor information under the law. But campaigns still make real choices about how many outside companies receive access to their data, how many commercial systems information passes through, and whether supporters are treated as human beings who have extended a specific trust or as names to be fed into a permanent political marketing apparatus.
We have chosen to minimize that exposure wherever we can.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9tZWxpc3NhNGNvbmdyZXNzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.Hv8PQ829FuIBe-GiTofIUYmRlU6fh6okShscgtyAdis?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=208845167)
Over the past several months, I have invested an enormous amount of my own time in building independent, non-extractive campaign operations and data systems. We run our own treasury and compliance work. We have built our own canvassing platform. We manage our own systems instead of automatically surrendering our campaign operations, supporter relationships, institutional knowledge, messaging strategy, and voter and supporter data to layers and layers of unknown, financially motivated external vendors.
We have designed and built this campaign, carefully and diligently, to be maximally financially efficient, maximally independent, and as secure as we can make it.
That work is not glamorous. It does not necessarily make national news. It does not generate dramatic headlines about the size of our campaign payroll. Most people will never see the hundreds - _thousands_ ... \- of decisions involved in building an operation that does not casually expose their information, waste their money, or make itself structurally dependent on institutions whose priorities may conflict with theirs.
**But we do this because we respect you.**
We honor your trust. We understand that when you donate, volunteer, sign up, attend an event, share a message, or tell us what is happening in your life, you are not surrendering yourself to an industry. **You are entering a relationship with a campaign that has an obligation to handle your money, your information, and your faith in us carefully.**
I am running to serve the people, not siphon from them. Unlike my opponents.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3260111&post_id=208845167&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA4ODQ1MTY3LCJpYXQiOjE3ODUzMzc0MTUsImV4cCI6MTc4NzkyOTQxNSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTMyNjAxMTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.FozE17-Zefc_hagiDv4GAIInTRvLiKrvvDiKpkAcz4M)
That means I will raise less money than candidates who build their campaigns around relentless fundraising. **That is a deliberate decision.** It protects my moral integrity. It reduces donor capture. It reduces the burden I place on people who are already paying too much for housing, food, healthcare, transportation, childcare, education, and nearly every other necessity of life.
**It also forces discipline.** When every dollar matters, spending must produce genuine value. We cannot treat our supporters as an inexhaustible reservoir that can be tapped whenever consultants want a larger budget or another layer of campaign machinery.
I will not bombard people with manipulative appeals simply to feed the electoral-industrial beast. I will not manufacture panic to empty your pockets. I will not tell you that democracy will end tonight unless you respond to an arbitrary fundraising deadline. I will not measure the strength of this movement only by the amount of money passing through its accounts.
I will ask for support honestly. I will tell you what it helps us accomplish. I will thank you for it. And I will use it as carefully as I know how.
There is a cost to that choice. Money is genuinely useful. A campaign with more resources can communicate with more voters, print more materials, hire more people, travel more widely, withstand more attacks, and build a larger public presence. We are running to win, not to stage a symbolic protest against campaign finance.
**So yes: please donate if you can.**
But know what your contribution supports.
**You are not helping us become more deeply integrated into the machine.** _You are helping us operate independently of it._ You are helping us reach people WITHOUT surrendering ourselves to the gatekeepers who claim to own the only paths by which people can be reached. You are helping us prove that political seriousness is not measured by the number of middlemen a campaign can afford.
The Democratic Party apparatus [tried to smother my last campaign](https://open.substack.com/pub/melissa4congress/p/the-democratic-party-eats-its-own?r=3zafez&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web). Its institutions famously protect incumbency, withhold access, narrow the definition of legitimacy, and treat grassroots democratic competition as a disruption to be contained rather than participation to be welcomed. In my case, the State Party actively tried to destroy my campaign by threatening me with a lawsuit and jail time over an accusation they knew full well was a lie. I have proof. It's in the link above.
**I ran anyway.**
Running as a first-time, grassroots candidate, I earned more than 90,000 votes. Coming out of nowhere, with no name recognition, on the shortest possible timeframe, I _still_ won my primary and advanced to the general election. I built a broad coalition across communities that political professionals often discuss abstractly as demographic categories but rarely take the time to know.
We communicated in fourteen languages. We distributed well more than 750,000 pieces of literature. We earned endorsements from organizations and Democratic legislative districts that were willing to look beyond institutional assumptions and judge the campaign on its values, integrity, work, and capacity. (We know that several organizations that supported us faced severe blowback from the approved Party incumbent ecosystem, as a consequence of their integrity and their support. **That 's not democracy.)**
We did not accomplish everything we set out to do. But we laid a solid foundation. And we proved that the gatekeepers do not possess all the keys.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9tZWxpc3NhNGNvbmdyZXNzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.Hv8PQ829FuIBe-GiTofIUYmRlU6fh6okShscgtyAdis?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=208845167)
I have learned that institutions frequently confuse their control of the customary route with control of the destination.
I learned that lesson in politics. **I learned it even more deeply in federal court.**
When my decorated, disabled, American military veteran husband - in wheelchair - was [illegally abducted by ICE from his citizenship appointment last year](https://open.substack.com/pub/melissa4congress/p/they-lost-in-court-they-still-tried?r=3zafez&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web), my family and I were thrown into a government machine built to dehumanize, belittle, exhaust, confuse, overwhelm, and destroy the people caught inside it.
_And my opponent, a political opportunist, capitalized on that catastrophe and my family 's pain and suffering for her own political gain._
We faced federal power without the protection, wealth, access, or professional representation that powerful people take for granted. I fought for justice and his freedom in 4 federal courts simultaneously, without lawyers, up against ICE, DHS, the DOJ, and the Attorney General of the United States. **I learned the machinery well enough to confront it on its own ground, and[I won.](https://open.substack.com/pub/melissa4congress/p/we-won-they-apologized-hes-coming?r=3zafez&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web)**
I know what institutional power looks like from the _inside_.
From the outside, it looks imposing. It surrounds itself with formal language, credentials, hierarchy, procedure, delay, intimidation, and the assumption that ordinary people will never understand enough to challenge it. It tries to make human beings feel small. It tries to convince them that resistance is futile, that truth is irrelevant, and that the institution's own declarations are the same thing as justice.
**But institutional power and actual strength are not the same.**
I know what it is to enter a machine designed to break you and come out victorious, with my soul intact. I know what it is to refuse corruption, refuse dehumanization, refuse despair, and expose the machine as something far shallower, crueler, more contradictory, and ultimately weaker than it first appeared.
**I am prepared to do the same in Congress.**
In the meantime, I am doing it in this campaign.
I am not running to become another captured partisan cog in an industry that thrives on outrage, dependency, and helplessness. I am not running to purchase a title at the cost of the _principles_ that made the title worth seeking. I am not running so that consultants can use my campaign as another feeding ground, or so that political institutions can absorb my work, neutralize its meaning, and tell me which truths are "professionally permissible."
I am running to win.
**I am running to serve.**
I am running to strengthen democracy _for real_ : by speaking the truth, educating and strengthening public understanding, protecting the people who place their trust in us, serving my constituents, and upholding the Constitution.
**I will not compromise my principles to prove that I am viable to institutions whose own moral and political viability is questionable at best.**
We are building something quieter than the political spectacle and stronger than it looks. It may not be visibly disruptive at first. It may not immediately feed the headline machine. It may not generate the noise that people have learned to mistake for power.
But it introduces one clear diamond into the maw of the machine--something it cannot digest, corrupt, or chew to powder.
Let us see what that can do to the gears.
**[Follow](https://substack.com/redirect/80392d1e-7203-4c06-92f7-dcacb5f010c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** this campaign for the message.
**[Share our work](https://substack.com/redirect/80392d1e-7203-4c06-92f7-dcacb5f010c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to spread truth, understanding, and democratic empowerment throughout the country.
**[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/5f5e5b9b-5d98-4bf0-aec5-983155ce1c9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** because independent work still requires resources, and because careful, principled infrastructure is worth building well.
**[Vote for me](https://substack.com/redirect/e1372cf0-efbe-4118-a81e-9220c81840f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** because integrity is not an ornament to leadership. It is the qualification on which every other promise depends.
Let's get to work.
**Care. Courage. The Constitution.**
[Vote Melissa for Congress.](https://substack.com/redirect/2b429484-d491-4304-bf3b-17d3142e5c50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
