body:
WFP champion Nikil Saval helped turn Pennsylvania’s Whole-Home Repairs model into federal law. | | | **A bold housing program that began right here in Pennsylvania is now part of federal law, Peter.** On July 11th, the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act became law after passing Congress with overwhelming bipartisan support. The law includes a federal Whole-Home Repairs pilot modeled on the Pennsylvania program that WFP champion State Senator **Nikil Saval** wrote and fought to pass during his first term. The idea behind Whole-Home Repairs is simple: **People shouldn’t be forced out of their homes because they can’t afford a new roof, a working furnace, or other essential repairs.** The program provides grants to low-and moderate-income homeowners for critical repairs, accessibility improvements, and energy-efficiency upgrades. It also supports repairs to affordable rental homes through loans to qualifying small landlords and invests in workforce training in the building trades. Nikil passed the program in 2022, just about a year and a half after taking office. At a time when Republicans controlled both chambers of the Pennsylvania legislature, he built support across party lines and turned a bold idea into a groundbreaking statewide program. **Now, that Pennsylvania idea has helped shape federal housing policy.** **[Will you split a contribution between Nikil Saval and the PA WFP today to support his leadership and help us elect more champions who will fight for working people?](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqt1KgGElNLHWwWbO_pXXNSCiKV1d2FzOYGpY2j7_yhzNi5SleFY2PODRJ_IoSAHlleLOYrHbZKBydbLzhPFEevtnphWe8WVhSyCYP1d3Sc5CVk35YlFjGyyI8ynUNoiwlrHP2CzRiLDNAnAL9kWwC0X0QE_c4bZkV87hxmGJ5jMFm157LnKQ4w2APzQwReCic0YBUiD-4bQz85W4xpEcaXFUzfsMSIa_VDzfdNnRrZcuYu2gPCqejxIbvgODMF_Du-a092pfpjDOmGb1Ui3Ed9aUsnqIlg1YR6dlItO5ZcjbEo3J_zfqOoDGG6Whr1qOSmKUdcSpUHrko9gLSrHll47ItViMRPJkY1sSW_cCkWlbg/4sq/0cCiiT5TTouhFzPhqIr5ow/h0/h001.Dtv11YoTcz8V2r7DtbfWtuePKHo5FO1Qj11B_QQuEjc)** **[Split a contribution](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqt1KgGElNLHWwWbO_pXXNSCiKV1d2FzOYGpY2j7_yhzNi5SleFY2PODRJ_IoSAHlleLOYrHbZKBydbLzhPFEevtpndrMgZhG6Fp2CcCzFFR6xXu8aOCFX-tgWQmkhXMdlpPfvEAzE04AnsfIwKigLKVZgIbFr0x42uNUa6meK2y1DpYLim3hPnD62adQSvrgA4WsAXiMLfAvv2AYjrOZWBu3LYkIwiMOJ7xBKPTdUVWS1ixuCVz6EsWkXV70EvjhdCqO2a0ypc_FgEsLysl6p7arUR_8-8vpaRm1xcg4pq5j1tc87EyMn2-M7W3_eiFjHFukP525111ZSxZ3LQjFAwXtLR8Gbsv5385rzgVnA1wMg/4sq/0cCiiT5TTouhFzPhqIr5ow/h1/h001.Bs11rOZKCv1IFyFnQI9rvb0NeqkPqQ3o7Bh8QhZ-e6U)** This victory didn’t happen overnight. As lawmakers and advocates across the country began looking to Whole-Home Repairs as a model, Nikil and his team kept pushing to bring the program to the federal level. He traveled to Washington, D.C., worked with federal policymakers, and helped build support for adopting the program nationally. clean_body: WFP champion Nikil Saval helped turn Pennsylvania’s Whole-Home Repairs model into federal law. | | | A bold housing program that began right here in Pennsylvania is now part of federal law, Peter. On July 11th, the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act became law after passing Congress with overwhelming bipartisan support. The law includes a federal Whole-Home Repairs pilot modeled on the Pennsylvania program that WFP champion State Senator Nikil Saval wrote and fought to pass during his first term. The idea behind Whole-Home Repairs is simple: People shouldn’t be forced out of their homes because they can’t afford a new roof, a working furnace, or other essential repairs. The program provides grants to low-and moderate-income homeowners for critical repairs, accessibility improvements, and energy-efficiency upgrades. It also supports repairs to affordable rental homes through loans to qualifying small landlords and invests in workforce training in the building trades. Nikil passed the program in 2022, just about a year and a half after taking office. At a time when Republicans controlled both chambers of the Pennsylvania legislature, he built support across party lines and turned a bold idea into a groundbreaking statewide program. Now, that Pennsylvania idea has helped shape federal housing policy. This victory didn’t happen overnight. As lawmakers and advocates across the country began looking to Whole-Home Repairs as a model, Nikil and his team kept pushing to bring the program to the federal level. He traveled to Washington, D.C., worked with federal policymakers, and helped build support for adopting the program nationally. That persistence paid off. Nearly 4,000 Pennsylvania households have already benefited from Whole-Home Repairs, with repairs continuing across the Commonwealth. The new federal pilot creates a path for communities across the country to build on that success. This is what it looks like when we elect WFP champions. Nikil took a problem working people were facing, developed a bold solution, and did the hard work required to make it real. His leadership shows what’s possible when elected officials answer to their communities and organized people have the power to back them up. | Friend,
---
What a turnaround!
---
After poll after poll showed the Democrats trouncing us in voter enthusiasm all year, the latest polling shows MAGA has finally regained the upper hand!
---
**Newsweek: “MAGA More Motivated Than Democrats for 2026 Midterms: Poll”**

“Trump/MAGA Republicans were the most likely to say they were "definitely going to vote" in the 2026 congressional midterm elections on November 3: **75 percent of MAGA respondents expressed that enthusiasm** [compared to] **63 percent of Democrats.”**
---
The best part? Our Party’s FIRST-EVER Midterm Convention at the end of the summer is the perfect opportunity to boost GOP voter enthusiasm even _further_!
---
__For MAGA, only 75% of our voters being “high propensity” who will “definitely” vote in the midterms is still close to the floor. We need to be aiming for the ceiling, which is 100%!__
---
But before I get ahead of myself, I want to highlight something important:
---
“Voter enthusiasm ahead of an election is... an early indicator of turnout strength and campaign engagement, **_although self-reported voting intention does not necessarily translate into actual turnout.”_ **
---
That last part is why we can’t take our foot off the gas for even a second.
---
**We need to capitalize on this new lead in enthusiasm by verifying every last Republican voter to ensure that they’re a “high propensity” voter who is actually going to show up to vote on – _or before_ – November 3rd. **
---
As long as we do that, we’ll win the midterms!
---
Given the vital importance of voter verification, I took it upon myself to review our Party’s list of voter profiles that were not fully verified as “high propensity” voters.
---
I’ll admit – I was surprised to see your name on there, Friend.
---
_That’s why I’m personally reaching out to ask _YOU_ to fully verify your profile. Because if we fully verify the remaining 25% of MAGA voters, our advantage will become insurmountable! _
---
[**Please complete the brief questionnaire to verify that YOU are among the highest propensity voters we can count on in the midterms – and then I’ll officially mark you as “verified” in the GOP’s Voter file.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

clean_body: Peggy admits she is a radical socialist. On record. In Minneapolis. | Peter - Bernie Sanders came to Minneapolis last week - on a private jet. He stood on a stage with Keith Ellison to rally support for Peggy Flanagan's campaign for the Senate. Peggy told the crowd she backs Medicare for All, universal child care, and a national paid leave mandate. Then she said this: she supports "ripping ICE apart..." Read that again. A candidate for the United States Senate wants to tear apart the agency that removes violent criminals from our communities. Peter, I need you with me on this one. I spent 21 years as a Marine and a Navy SEAL fighting threats to this country overseas. Nine deployments. Over 70 countries. I didn't do that, so a Bernie Sanders-endorsed candidate could dismantle everything I fought to defend overseas from within our borders. I am proud of my service to our great nation and of my fight to defend our American way of life overseas. My promise to you is that I will continue the fight - this time at home. This is the choice Minnesota is facing: a candidate cheered on by Bernie Sanders and Ilhan Omar who wants to gut the agency keeping violent criminals off our streets, or a former SEAL who spent his career making sure threats never made it to America. If we win this seat, it's because grassroots supporters like you showed up when it mattered. Thank you for standing with me, Adam Schwarze Former Navy SEAL Minnesota Republican Party Endorsed Candidate for U.S. Senate FOLLOW ADAM ON SOCIAL MEDIA | | Paid for by Schwarze for Senate Adam Schwarze is a former Navy SEAL and Marine. body:

Here’s a real question for you: What do you even call a misogynistic primadonna who’s unbelievably reckless with taxpayer dollars, not to mention our actual national security and the safety of our troops?
There’s no word that does this man justice, so I guess we’ll just call him Pete Hegseth.
Yes, I’m back to talk about our Secretary of Defense, and how he’s running the department like a personal vanity project.
Right now, the U.S. is spending billions of dollars on an illegal war in Iran.
And while this reckless war drags on, causing needless death and accomplishing nothing, Hegseth had the nerve to ask Congress for another $67 billion to fund it — taking the total cost of this war past $100 billion. But it’s not just an illegal war, reporting has shown your tax dollars are also bankrolling the Pentagon’s staggering spending sprees!
In one month alone, Hegseth spent $93 billion (yes, BILLION) on ridiculous, frivolous luxuries:
* $98,329 on a grand piano for the Air Force chief of staff’s home
* $9 million on king crab and lobster tail
* $15.1 million on ribeye steak
* $225 million on furniture, including $12,000 fruit basket stands and more than $60,000 worth of designer recliners
This particular spending happened just days before our government shut down for the longest time in U.S. history, and millions of Americans lost their SNAP benefits, went without pay, and worried about how they were going to feed their families.
It’s sick.
And instead of focusing on the reckless war in Iran or getting his budget in order, Pete Hegseth is so vain that he took the time to ban the photographers who took ‘unflattering’ photos of him during a briefing.
By all accounts, he’s just as worried about the lighting in the press he’s getting as our national security or service members’ safety. (Don’t get me started on the personal makeup studio he wanted at the Pentagon.)
Donald Trump spent years promising his supporters he would “drain the swamp.” But the truth is, he filled the government with some of the most corrupt and unserious people imaginable, and Pete Hegseth might be the worst and most dangerous example.
Our troops deserve serious, thoughtful leadership, and American taxpayers deserve accountability for where their hard-earned money is going. We saw with Kristi Noem’s firing that public outrage can impact this administration’s personnel decisions — so let’s stay loud about this.
If you agree Pete Hegseth is unfit to serve as Secretary of Defense, add your name to my petition right now demanding his resignation. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/IXnjqCOLnUe2HA-8WgyFeQ2]
ADD MY NAME [https://secure.ngpvan.com/IXnjqCOLnUe2HA-8WgyFeQ2]
The longer Hegseth stays in power, the more damage he does — to our military, to our nation’s credibility, and to the American people’s trust.
Thank you for speaking out with me.
Sara

subject: Sick of all the sky-is-falling emails from the GOP?
body:
Finally, some good news!
---
| | | | | |
---
| | | | | [View in browser](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTJ9AAwAAAAAAgh_yH8OkX670c2f6URaAWqwnzVvsyOvITW9bDD7iIy4eQRfQF_3dU3PC0z1yf9_pecwfX2mztyOZ59vuTCtZvAyyMpKWbcech81Q9qN2w "View in Browser")
---
_**A Special Message from our Sponsor**_ _Please note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of_ _Free Speech Daily_ _and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by Free Speech Daily_ _._
---
| Jim Jordan Finally, some good news! | | Friend,
---
What a turnaround!
---
After poll after poll showed the Democrats trouncing us in voter enthusiasm all year, the latest polling shows MAGA has finally regained the upper hand!
---
**Newsweek: “MAGA More Motivated Than Democrats for 2026 Midterms: Poll”**

“Trump/MAGA Republicans were the most likely to say they were "definitely going to vote" in the 2026 congressional midterm elections on November 3: **75 percent of MAGA respondents expressed that enthusiasm** [compared to] **63 percent of Democrats.”**
---
The best part? Our Party’s FIRST-EVER Midterm Convention at the end of the summer is the perfect opportunity to boost GOP voter enthusiasm even _further_!
---
__For MAGA, only 75% of our voters being “high propensity” who will “definitely” vote in the midterms is still close to the floor. We need to be aiming for the ceiling, which is 100%!__
---
But before I get ahead of myself, I want to highlight something important:
---
“Voter enthusiasm ahead of an election is... an early indicator of turnout strength and campaign engagement, **_although self-reported voting intention does not necessarily translate into actual turnout.”_ **
---
That last part is why we can’t take our foot off the gas for even a second.
---
**We need to capitalize on this new lead in enthusiasm by verifying every last Republican voter to ensure that they’re a “high propensity” voter who is actually going to show up to vote on – _or before_ – November 3rd. **
---
As long as we do that, we’ll win the midterms!
---
Given the vital importance of voter verification, I took it upon myself to review our Party’s list of voter profiles that were not fully verified as “high propensity” voters.
---
I’ll admit – I was surprised to see your name on there, Friend.
---
_That’s why I’m personally reaching out to ask _YOU_ to fully verify your profile. Because if we fully verify the remaining 25% of MAGA voters, our advantage will become insurmountable! _
---
[**Please complete the brief questionnaire to verify that YOU are among the highest propensity voters we can count on in the midterms – and then I’ll officially mark you as “verified” in the GOP’s Voter file.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTJ9AAwAAAAAAgh_yH8PcxvKGguw1SWqBvLL_KS3X2H3Wulq812nFR09nO3ws2qoOpD7IQUNawqVw9NE35uPWtj4Sr4L6LqGCf9apY0Xumb0EmQKqgRw6A)

| Hi Peter,

Some of the most important work we've done in Richmond this year never made the front page.

You probably heard about the assault weapons ban. You may have seen the news about paid sick leave or insulin costs. Those are real wins, and I'm proud of them.

_But there's a lot more that didn't make headlines._

We **cracked down on prior authorization delays** — the insurance company tactic of making patients wait weeks for approval on care their doctor already ordered.

We required Marketplace insurers to offer plans that **cap monthly out-of-pocket drug costs.**

We passed legislation to **make sure data centers don't drive up electricity bills** for Virginia families.

We **reformed how Virginia manages its correctional facilities** , and serious assaults on corrections staff dropped 56 percent in five months. We launched a new advisory council to make those reforms permanent.

None of that is glamorous. Not all of it trends on social media. But all of it changes lives.

Governing well means doing the unglamorous work — the bills that fix the systems people interact with every day without realizing it, until something goes wrong. I came to Richmond to do that work, and I am proud of what we have accomplished so far.

name: Sue Anderbois
subject: What I've learned
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of AnderBois
body:
| |
---
Hi friend, This campaign has taught me so much. It’s taught me how lucky I am to be able to call Rhode Island home. It’s taught me how many inspiring, motivated, and dedicated people we have living here. It’s reinforced how much opportunity we have to actually improve people’s lives. And it has also taught me why we keep missing this opportunity. We cannot keep electing the same kinds of leaders – the slick politicians who glide into office through their wealthy networks or empty promises – and expect different results. We need people in office who are excited to serve. Who will roll up their sleeves and do the unglamorous work to make real change. Who are willing to stick their neck out on important issues. Who show up even when the cameras aren’t rolling. Who know that Rhode Islanders deserve more. I have a friend who jokes that I am running this campaign on “hard” mode. I don’t have excessive personal wealth to self-fund, and I am not taking corporate PAC money. I never make a promise I don’t intend to keep and fight like heck to achieve – and I certainly don’t make commitments in hopes of getting a campaign check. This shouldn’t be the “hard” way to run a campaign – **it should be the right, and the only way**. But you and I both know that’s not the case. Our campaign relies on grassroots supporters like you who believe that we can elect a different kind of leader this fall. So I’m asking for your help. You might have seen in my last email update that we shot an ad. I can’t wait to share it with you. But, we **still need to raise $15,000** to get it up on the air and make sure that it reaches enough voters before the primary on September 9th. Can you chip in today to help us reach our goal and take our message statewide?
---

With gratitude, Sue

| | Peter, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, _**[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=0a0bfa99dba046a1bde21d89bbdd4ac2&_e=i2YrD9UK0TXRRVqT9cdAr3TnKxTBkG3bz8drDgk9bODVNI-FxGF746HoDuPaq2H9Yg6gb8YfGwlYj93vzGq6cHMYyzszNTi5z7wokowPmRgEwUC1kLyxpCAVeAcosYzXHl_7L1EE86EkfdwTJKqeNF0ZTUKx7Wszz_ILjN6eq4LFAa54AKECGQL59M-uX2nAdrwQRn1m8EMYBAbxo0nTWST4gQ55eoQVIlri-9fDGtRD2O9SAx2mOLw2tqs19QiDxKuGV4Q8N3F8_po4XgY1RdKTHtYl-Tlk43RO0W4XADm4IsPJA3x1hyg4EX1adx9fbK9O4lbZ-FkrX6ZP1yJmqRHdVTITRYg9TSy2cYWFTGPR376uLJKNqWixD-a09CKdWfjA9Xafth5xWky2SSX6ezNRO_7mdW4SrgUQbIAATdK4yDjNkZGP-P9hNclbN5dPEsTAUOunxMUsHEgaK5i7nB-Mc9MXwzkyodBHJNRD5-nKr4eoytQGXu9PKkhRfZ0Ki45x_qXFwDGaSSEMCucFaAiE9qvZHqqseoOCzJjGICvRH3jpsGouEqlt_1mx6E8FW7URvyHoLIM-ffZWpoeVrE5rswaGZ0Jds-QwP37_sm8bNdjAGSYIlLxzBrG30TwXwcHyQYdl5Uru1y8kgv8_CFNgJ36Iqspm-IvhbTAxRhKgjaNHk-N16NKN7h0nT0sZv9bxnyxUzoGqz1lrjRxxtJq54itCSATJEPSSZvZgAVk%3D)**_ Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An _ABC_ _board_ _book_ for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby_. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...

| | _**[That’s why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through See You At The Library Day.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=0a0bfa99dba046a1bde21d89bbdd4ac2&_e=i2YrD9UK0TXRRVqT9cdAr3TnKxTBkG3bz8drDgk9bODVNI-FxGF746HoDuPaq2H9Yg6gb8YfGwlYj93vzGq6cHMYyzszNTi5z7wokowPmRgEwUC1kLyxpCAVeAcosYzXHl_7L1EE86EkfdwTJKqeNF0ZTUKx7Wszz_ILjN6eq4LFAa54AKECGQL59M-uX2nAdrwQRn1m8EMYBAbxo0nTWST4gQ55eoQVIlri-9fDGtRD2O9SAx2mOLw2tqs19QiDr-UTmBM1EWb4djKNgC89UtnXBOsY2M5j6jfbzJUgCJppHoI3GmwO4sJQWg4ohpmPCgqJ6Thi7tn24O-17ML6Vr6mp9geZgTteCcXS87YhoPfyvJTJjRQjjx2NbhQExSDT30dsaHeSpZh3QgdPoKV__6zD2Ll8yIjEQ2Eu7-NL-yPKUODlK8MEchOdji5TRgUvOx_0IUvUlo6LI2EU1CTmPP9DMM70XB8tcPsbBKCyz-Q9vVgV76V9LwXQG3m6JLYdMtOJtt_pBvbxHP9UA-Vkvj9kUqAXJ2McJCE0Dt_p6xmUu98kDqf0fTSGR4naa4VE4aMX-949vdN0dJyBSVJ8h4HCULztjN5rab_ipjEaZ4kpj6tEuvj6MtmaTV5kVdg_lCoPJudkQLW1OT1XjshTiEUnS3TPrZubRR19DTrkpX765dg-JjdmWbm_-lQxeMu6hqnmBDWr-XyD8hdwC2A9G0JtABEIN8DfGgQ2AIkQAM%3D)**_ For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of _other_ children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!_**[I hope you see why I need your help today.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=0a0bfa99dba046a1bde21d89bbdd4ac2&_e=i2YrD9UK0TXRRVqT9cdAr3TnKxTBkG3bz8drDgk9bODVNI-FxGF746HoDuPaq2H9Yg6gb8YfGwlYj93vzGq6cHMYyzszNTi5z7wokowPmRgEwUC1kLyxpCAVeAcosYzXHl_7L1EE86EkfdwTJKqeNF0ZTUKx7Wszz_ILjN6eq4LFAa54AKECGQL59M-uX2nAdrwQRn1m8EMYBAbxo0nTWST4gQ55eoQVIlri-9fDGtRD2O9SAx2mOLw2tqs19QiD-Zhk1vJVGX01Ua2iPpUqYK0EoPP0AlCImLvwvgnu2VrTgYdx-FPXSWgg8caSa9I-wZg5mPujkIm5k-DDNNP-g27_-t0jLbxmBi-DaHAhVgRyap3uc595IPHFPIeYAFP4QwdNgiQdGOLOpRl4PfAMtITh3Ea9xZMwKDB8NUQf1KkjzEivQd8NtF1QNveyXaIb0YeYzjUvZOWuk3VrnkH8z_qHkfwgbowP0Uwi-P7DMImTXEuW6yFWQHTwQYGYSMgiwumCAW24W1nFIYz4GwqiA4vHlxrW0rhEC_QcfFsLxW4I06P76jbXgCe8QFNRUFzK41UXk6ouWpz2qjhL9xOpDIWKzivufux1pG6L2UtFRKJaYGPU0_P22DLLmzyVsepoosUJZ4jvHx4ZyMhfYokr2z9zBhkRLUmj7fk7QcM8BP7cAOTp_9nKlSj7Q2OMxobiowUP56Nm-ZcRbIIeRGGlCZ5GJewsJTgL7HE4yMPZ1mA%3D) **_My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with _conservative Story Hours_ filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that onebit.>> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. _**[And this year, honoring America’s 250th birthday, my ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to reach 250,000 children.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=0a0bfa99dba046a1bde21d89bbdd4ac2&_e=i2YrD9UK0TXRRVqT9cdAr3TnKxTBkG3bz8drDgk9bODVNI-FxGF746HoDuPaq2H9Yg6gb8YfGwlYj93vzGq6cHMYyzszNTi5z7wokowPmRgEwUC1kLyxpCAVeAcosYzXHl_7L1EE86EkfdwTJKqeNF0ZTUKx7Wszz_ILjN6eq4LFAa54AKECGQL59M-uX2nAdrwQRn1m8EMYBAbxo0nTWST4gQ55eoQVIlri-9fDGtRD2O9SAx2mOLw2tqs19QiDzCpMDrZF-gAUloB3Y0Bz_4hTV0je0DXZHcnSjBu7Iteku3CJcXg7SqUFlPmKmS9FEhOdEKA0cKCfkF7OR5h3je4E3ZQk_jADyjdn3mvEOiyH6cOczj-JcmfNOO2ycQ6uLJu3lSRjra9Cet9VT_D8JvX5Leu3e85E-dVoRZDyoWjG44NXj3I5x_IgQwltPK1EvUB7X_GSiQrRvbOpjyJWl-VqO2j8D3Ac_wPaN9l8_YZGzoD0MS3L54NSS4nsKoXi7M4b3CCUP0MNcimR0j1sv-IWSylIyQ0v81hfNejGhZPHK7Ub-n7kuEUpiKiykkzZdbN5LEW6UrPoQwV9pyvtxmiuYcOpVJPGs-Bug-75djhdQ3o9va58xVNcSsgGBprHl6kyVhJIbwow9FrstHYD4ohV-BPZZoFHIodZi0aZJjpEzTEm1WAb8jydFpBuO1CmJxIri6oxoldutU2Qj8wuYr7fNqC5uVX4nU65E_9QbHo%3D)**_ The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. _**[That’s why I’ve teamed with a very special non-profit called BRAVE for Good to make this year’s “See You at the Library Day” a bigger success than ever.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=0a0bfa99dba046a1bde21d89bbdd4ac2&_e=i2YrD9UK0TXRRVqT9cdAr3TnKxTBkG3bz8drDgk9bODVNI-FxGF746HoDuPaq2H9Yg6gb8YfGwlYj93vzGq6cHMYyzszNTi5z7wokowPmRgEwUC1kLyxpCAVeAcosYzXHl_7L1EE86EkfdwTJKqeNF0ZTUKx7Wszz_ILjN6eq4LFAa54AKECGQL59M-uX2nAdrwQRn1m8EMYBAbxo0nTWST4gQ55eoQVIlri-9fDGtRD2O9SAx2mOLw2tqs19QiDrW2w2TQUEZED7yIW6bzXUfwzGuzWcGacpX4WQ5uEohRIM-iByY0iAdjkx--BNW8U1F07lVU10_rSUYOtp7u5ehFvZ7pGuDukJup0zLWUrbCYvneSKCna4LJNHZr9iy_EoXdw9nL3OeekHBdz1c5FMnnvV63qbCUP1FI20g3f5O1S8NhPzrP_0V161qDrb6hVH5dJM3dOng2kqzWmnaByXztwB3Eyfhg8khESY2rY2Gj1srJiOxOElmWOnOLho5En4FsOCssYLKrAFBLgV2KK4cYnrJ7PQwT7lMwxJv4bna7OOtKi8pfwhmH4AvhQ1JI7sa78Gqaty6JZG_rx9Y7k36F59rt1K2cjUp8UzwMRqkvcU12_Kt8Y8Wll6a0hCqUfxir6Zza3Jis88BrbbAWXR-xlANnmN2OobQpTz9oVkyJu42x6t4F9gb1tcdPEwBggGRDpCsTw3fRQYrbnxSaHpvmy94w9oS7u7siyNaqTGHk%3D)**_ **BRAVE for Good** was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift.Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries.We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. _**[Knowing that, please consider a sponsorship gift of $125. That’s enough to sponsor one entire ‘Story Hour Kit’ yourself.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=0a0bfa99dba046a1bde21d89bbdd4ac2&_e=i2YrD9UK0TXRRVqT9cdAr3TnKxTBkG3bz8drDgk9bODVNI-FxGF746HoDuPaq2H9Yg6gb8YfGwlYj93vzGq6cHMYyzszNTi5z7wokowPmRgEwUC1kLyxpCAVeAcosYzXHl_7L1EE86EkfdwTJKqeNF0ZTUKx7Wszz_ILjN6eq4LFAa54AKECGQL59M-uX2nAdrwQRn1m8EMYBAbxo0nTWST4gQ55eoQVIlri-9fDGtRD2O9SAx2mOLw2tqs19QiD4_ga8CzSugrMmIZAFrNEl6oZ0OGOMMebM6MNWU-BHA2w2iA_yN8UHp2dcf6BKa6xJz5RQdvU5hqKxml2fxBNsLKAEkds3GhqYYw81Qs03dxFUTsdpAevfOArzhyx5e2GvLb0lFQpLsq5lFp6tu7rj0rceSvfUiBrAATUWgYEjXceWLbaUGXziUCFBzHQ_ihFDTeuwSVrXsAxwofE6Z47T6DwS-JRKlnbkohU-2MFctXyTFWPZ_-xFN75kSLW94KwxgiVuYLQDg5-sQqPVm--IJysN9R9ZQ-VRXB5t1XLmxOUofBqXBOqw318FvA_7Wcl7idTMPBQBbTysPMKZy34Dll1osdnJYfkrFNpu1lUfWPbLjMuiKOJXvMXlPgte-o9qspz5xamhCejoJklkLE5helbd4CfO7xPIn25G2taOwvseriqeGXvz57mpvx8oDtkxJ8bWPD3r1S-SUxi61wipSusbduYn-waB21yCY5RnfY%3D)**_ Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: We have to be willing to name the mistakes that got us in this mess in the first place.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
We need a firewall against this administration that is hellbent on tearing down in four years what it took us 250 years to build.
Donald Trump will stop at nothing to stay in power.
We have no time to waste. The question is not if we need to win a majority. The question is how we win a durable majority in Congress.
How do we make our country a land of opportunity and affordability for the working class once again? We have to be willing to name the mistakes that got us in this mess in the first place.
Because it wasn’t just that Donald Trump won, it was that Democrats lost.
The moment we are willing to admit and name some of the causes of that, is the same moment we can start turning the ship around.
**We as Democrats have a responsibility to win and to make working people’s lives better.**
To make our healthcare affordable, our wages higher, our unions stronger, and our air breathable.
[But this fight doesn't get won by playing it safe. If I can count on your support today, donate to power our campaign for progress. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260729-1.NicjDd&refcode=em20260729-12027-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=12027%2E2526796%2EomVyo3)

name: Dan Ahlers
subject: Last night, Larry Rhoden said something about me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ahlers for Governor
body:
Larry Rhoden said there was no place in Pierre for a person like me. What does he mean by that?

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/1b5ab34be21d/health-care-you-deserve-10597626?e=cee7b49c04)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/IyXoP6IfC61?e=cee7b49c04&c2id=3adc23449cf80dcda430cceaf3c4b05d)
[|

|

| | | | | | Folks,
Last night on Dakota News Now, Larry Rhoden and Tony Venhuizen were asked about me. Their answer: the Capitol in Pierre has no place for a person like me.
I've been asking myself since: what do they mean, a person like me?
A person who's spent his career working across the aisle instead of running from it?
A person who served in the minority and still got things done, because I showed up and did the work regardless of who held the gavel?
A small business owner who's put his own money and time back into his hometown?
A person who represented one of the most conservative districts in this state because I knocked on almost every single door and talked to almost every single voter, instead of assuming I already had it?
That's the person they say doesn't belong in Pierre.
Here's what I think is really going on. After nearly 50 years of one-party rule, the GOP has started acting like the Capitol is theirs by birthright, not something voters lend them term by term. They're not afraid of my politics. They're afraid of what I represent: that showing up and earning it still works. That's a threat to a party that's stopped believing it has to.
To me, that’s complacency dressed up as entitlement. And the true sign of contempt for a place isn't hostility; it's assuming you don't have to keep earning it.
I love South Dakota too much to accept that. I am a South Dakotan. And South Dakotans don't need permission from Pierre to have a seat at the table. We’ll build the table instead.
South Dakota is the greatest state in the union. _**Let's start acting like it deserves better than complacency.**_
Forever fighting for you,Dan Ahlers _Your Candidate for Governor_

# [Miami's tallest tower nears sellout amid executive wealth migration](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6fc1e0-ee6d-4ab0-bfcf-709f2176349b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Cipriani Residences Miami, the city's tallest residential tower at nearly 950 feet, has topped off construction and is more than 80% sold to buyers from over 30 countries who are making South Florida their primary home.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5a805ab9-324c-42b6-8753-dec5e551616c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **International buyer surge:** Leading markets include Mexico, Italy, Colombia, Brazil, Venezuela, Argentina, Canada, France, Spain and the United Kingdom, plus domestic buyers from high-tax New York and California.
* **Celebrity and executive demand:** Soccer star Lionel Messi purchased four units, followed by other Argentine players, while executives from Citadel and Amazon allegedly relocate and buy into the 85-story project.
* **2027 delivery timeline:** The development remains the only new residential tower planned for Brickell and is on track to deliver completed homes next year after recent topping off.
* **Pro-business appeal cited:** Developer Camilo Miguel Jr. highlights Miami's business-friendly climate as a key reason hedge funds and financial firms move top earners and operations from New York.

# [Microsoft's AI billions just faced a brutal reality check](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6fc1e0-ee6d-4ab0-bfcf-709f2176349b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Microsoft reports fourth-quarter results after the closing bell Wednesday as shares fall more than 18% year-to-date and investors demand clear evidence that heavy AI capital spending is generating meaningful returns.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6fc1e0-ee6d-4ab0-bfcf-709f2176349b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Capex surge expected:** The company is projected to spend $35.2 billion on capital expenditures excluding leases, a 106% year-over-year jump that fuels free cash flow concerns among investors.
* **Azure growth target:** Bank of America analysts say Microsoft must deliver Azure cloud growth of 39% to 40% or better this quarter to ease spending-related jitters.
* **Revenue projections rise:** Consensus calls for $4.25 earnings per share on $87.7 billion in revenue, with Intelligent Cloud at $38.1 billion and Azure reaching $39.5 billion.
* **Rivals show contrast:** Amazon shares are up less than 1% and Google more than 3% this year while Microsoft faces capacity constraints limiting AI service demand fulfillment.

# [Chip crash + daily leverage resets = instant wealth evaporation](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6fc1e0-ee6d-4ab0-bfcf-709f2176349b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The semiconductor sell-off has hammered leveraged products as the iShares Semiconductor ETF fell roughly 25% from its June 22 peak while the Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X Shares plunged nearly two-thirds in the same period.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6fc1e0-ee6d-4ab0-bfcf-709f2176349b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Recovery path grows steeper:** SOXX requires a gain of roughly 33% to erase its 25% drop, but SOXL would need to rally around 170% to recover from its approximately 63% plunge.
* **Leveraged ETF notional remains high:** The 200 largest leveraged ETFs still represent more than $400 billion in notional value after dropping roughly $100 billion over the past month, staying near record levels according to Baird Strategas.
* **Daily resets drive divergence:** The 3X fund is designed only to deliver three times the daily return of the semiconductor index, so multi-week results compound differently and do not equal three times the index move.
* **Strategist sees limited damage:** Baird Strategas chief ETF strategist Todd Sohn described the retreat bluntly as "Barely a scratch here thus far" relative to the prior leveraged ETF boom.

# [AI debt fears spark explosive surge in credit default swaps](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6fc1e0-ee6d-4ab0-bfcf-709f2176349b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Demand for AI-linked credit default swaps has surged as the cost of insuring debt from companies such as Oracle, Nvidia and Apple against default rises amid strain on their bonds.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6fc1e0-ee6d-4ab0-bfcf-709f2176349b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **CDS definition clarified:** A credit default swap is a derivative that provides protection against the risk that a bond issuer such as a company or government fails to meet its debt obligations.
* **Insurance against default:** Bond investors use CDS to hedge the risk of missing interest payments or principal repayment, functioning effectively as insurance against a credit event.
* **AI spending drives demand:** The instruments, which gained prominence during the 2008 financial crisis, are seeing increased interest linked to heavy AI investments and borrowing.
* **Market signals caution:** Rising CDS costs reflect investor worries over how much the corporate sector is spending on AI infrastructure and the associated debt levels.

# [Nike China sales crash 30% as local rivals crush the giant](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6fc1e0-ee6d-4ab0-bfcf-709f2176349b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nike's China revenue has shrunk 30% since 2021 to an eight-year low by the end of May, even as the country's sportswear market expanded 51% over five years, amid a shift to domestic brands.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6fc1e0-ee6d-4ab0-bfcf-709f2176349b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Eight quarters of declines:** Sales have fallen year-over-year for eight consecutive quarters, turning the once fastest-growing high-margin region into Nike's smallest market and a drag on its global turnaround.
* **China Chic drives preference:** Younger shoppers favor Anta and Li-Ning over foreign premium brands following the Guochao campaign and 2021 Xinjiang cotton controversy that sparked boycotts and sneaker burnings.
* **Localization efforts accelerate:** New Greater China GM Cathy Sparks is hiring a first local product creation VP and launching China-designed lifestyle capsules for the holidays to meet hyperlocal demands.
* **Distribution reset planned:** Sparks is unwinding a messy post-Covid online model run by physical distributors, a move analysts say could cut up to $1 billion in revenue but aims to restore full-price sales and clarity.

* * *
* * *
# [Taco Bell food safety nightmare overshadows every Yum Brands win](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6fc1e0-ee6d-4ab0-bfcf-709f2176349b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Yum Brands prepares to report second-quarter results Thursday as a cyclosporiasis outbreak linked to Taco Bell iceberg lettuce sickens at least 1,947 people and drives double-digit traffic declines at the chain.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6fc1e0-ee6d-4ab0-bfcf-709f2176349b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Outbreak sickens nearly two thousand:** The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reports 1,947 cases, 98 hospitalizations and zero deaths as of Friday, with Taylor Farms iceberg lettuce named the likely source by federal agencies.
* **Traffic plunges and shares drop:** Daily visits to Taco Bell locations fell by double digits per Placer.ai data while Yum shares declined 5%, cutting the company's market value to about $42 billion.
* **Twin growth engine under pressure:** Taco Bell remains one of Yum's key drivers alongside KFC international after the recent $2.7 billion Pizza Hut divestiture, heightening focus on the chain's recovery.
* **Analysts cut later estimates:** Wall Street projects $1.58 earnings per share on $2.2 billion revenue for the quarter ending before the link, yet several analysts lowered full-year and second-half forecasts after the selloff.

* * *
* * *
# [BMW plans to axe 8,000 jobs by the end of 2027](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6fc1e0-ee6d-4ab0-bfcf-709f2176349b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Premium carmaker BMW plans to offer almost half its German staff voluntary redundancy in a bid to cut 8,000 jobs by the end of 2027, a company source told AFP.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6fc1e0-ee6d-4ab0-bfcf-709f2176349b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Voluntary German program:** The company will offer severance packages to roughly half of its German employees, targeting administrative and development roles while production workers are spared.
* **Timeline through 2027:** The voluntary redundancy program is set to begin later this year and run through the end of 2027 as part of the efficiency drive.
* **Market pressures cited:** Weaker China sales, intensifying Chinese electric-vehicle competition, U.S. tariffs and high European costs are driving the planned reductions.
* **Industry-wide pattern:** The move follows similar workforce actions at other German automakers facing the same competitive and cost challenges.

* * *
* * *
# [Tech billionaire ordered to pay a crushing $645 million divorce bill](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6fc1e0-ee6d-4ab0-bfcf-709f2176349b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A South Korean court ordered SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won to pay his former wife Roh Soh-yeong about $645 million, the largest divorce asset award in the country's history and lower than a prior $935 million ruling.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6fc1e0-ee6d-4ab0-bfcf-709f2176349b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Cash payment required:** The Seoul High Court ordered the 944 billion won settlement paid in cash rather than stock to protect Chey's control of the conglomerate through his 17.9% stake in SK Inc.
* **Investor reaction follows:** Shares of SK Inc. closed 3.8% lower and SK Hynix fell 8.3% in Seoul trading after the Friday ruling renewed scrutiny of how Chey will finance the award.
* **Marital property share:** Judges awarded Roh one-third of the couple's marital property after finding she contributed to preserving and increasing the family's wealth during the marriage.
* **Appeal remains possible:** Either side may appeal the decision, potentially returning the property-division dispute to the Supreme Court after earlier rejection of claims involving her father's financial support.

| | | | | [|

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
Dear friend,
**The momentum is building.** Across our district, neighbors are coming together, sharing their concerns, and joining a campaign focused on listening, solving problems, and creating a better future for Ohio. Here’s what’s happening this week — and how you can be part of it.
---
|
---
|
---
| | **ELECTION MATTERS**
**Geauga County Kickoff**
**July 16:** The campaign kickoff in Geauga was everything we hoped for and more — a packed room, new friends, longtime neighbors, and incredible energy for what’s ahead. To everyone who showed up, signed up, chipped in, or came to listen: thank you. This campaign belongs to all of us. This is what happens when a community comes together and says it’s ready for something better. A special thank you to our hosts and volunteers who made the evening so welcoming at Veterans Legacy Woods Hall at Geauga Park District.
---
|
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/olZKSMWN7N0?e=27fb4eb2bd&c2id=b0ca7ec63a2b76e887e5a7a711fa5261)
| |
Data center activity and opposition have grown significantly since I began this campaign in February.
People are making their voices heard: they don’t want large-scale data centers moving forward without answers, protections, and proper regulations in place.Last Monday, Conneaut residents filled council chambers beyond capacity to speak about the future of their community. The overwhelming majority called for a one-year moratorium on data centers.
I was proud to stand with them. My message to council was simple: pause, listen, and put the right safeguards in place before decisions are made.
The moratorium will move to second and third readings, giving residents another opportunity to make their voices heard.
Decisions are made by the people who show up. Keep showing up, Conneaut.
---
|

[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/Dd816DcVJaa?e=27fb4eb2bd&c2id=b0ca7ec63a2b76e887e5a7a711fa5261)
| |
**MARIA’S IDEAS****Big tech didn’t ask. They took.**
Ohio communities are waking up to a troubling pattern: decisions about massive data center developments are being made before residents ever get a voice. From Perry Village to Shalersville, families are discovering that open fields, quiet neighborhoods, and local resources could be transformed without meaningful public input. Maria Jukic breaks down what’s happening, why communities are pushing back, and why Ohioans deserve the power to decide what happens in their own backyards.

Across our district, neighbors are coming together, sharing their concerns, and joining a campaign focused on listening, solving problems, and creating a better future for Ohio. Here’s what’s happening this week — and how you can be part of it. | | | | ELECTION MATTERS Geauga County Kickoff July 16: The campaign kickoff in Geauga was everything we hoped for and more — a packed room, new friends, longtime neighbors, and incredible energy for what’s ahead. To everyone who showed up, signed up, chipped in, or came to listen: thank you. This campaign belongs to all of us. This is what happens when a community comes together and says it’s ready for something better. A special thank you to our hosts and volunteers who made the evening so welcoming at Veterans Legacy Woods Hall at Geauga Park District. | | | Data center activity and opposition have grown significantly since I began this campaign in February. People are making their voices heard: they don’t want large-scale data centers moving forward without answers, protections, and proper regulations in place.Last Monday, Conneaut residents filled council chambers beyond capacity to speak about the future of their community. The overwhelming majority called for a one-year moratorium on data centers. I was proud to stand with them. My message to council was simple: pause, listen, and put the right safeguards in place before decisions are made. The moratorium will move to second and third readings, giving residents another opportunity to make their voices heard. Decisions are made by the people who show up. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: I’m heartbroken, and I’m angry.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
On Sunday, a horrific act of gun violence occurred at our beloved Bite of Seattle festival at the Seattle Center.
#
Peter,
On Sunday, a horrific act of gun violence occurred at our beloved Bite of Seattle festival at the Seattle Center—where this year, like every year, 300,000 people attended this glorious 3-day celebration of diverse foods, culture and music. Three people died and four more were injured. Many, many more were traumatized by the violence, and devastated by the fear of not being safe anywhere. Across our city, questions are ringing out about what happened and what we can do about this violence.
Two nights ago, I attended a community-led vigil at the Seattle Center. I met the families of two of the victims who died in the shooting at Seattle Center on Sunday. I heard the pain in the voices of fathers who had lost their kids to gun violence before. I saw the fear of every single person who doesn’t want to be afraid when they go to a food festival or a shopping mall. I saw the terror in parents who want to know that their kids will come home alive from a movie theater or from school. I saw the anger and frustration of the community that had gathered about why there are so many guns on the streets, and why we haven’t been able to stop this senseless violence. As we honored the names of those who had died, our candles and phone lights symbolizing a path forward in the darkness, my heart was breaking.
The United States is a global outlier in gun violence. We have the highest rate of civilian gun ownership and the highest rate of gun-related homicides and deaths among all wealthy peer nations. Our firearm homicide rate is 77 times higher than Germany, 33 times higher than Australia, and 19 times higher than France. At the same time, we are the only wealthy country that does not provide universal health care that covers mental health. Post-secondary education is out of reach for too many young people. And housing is too damn expensive everywhere in the country. There is too much hopelessness, too much propping up of violence from the very top levels of government, and yes, too many guns on our streets. This is NOT what we should be known for.
Washington state is a state that has taken real action on sensible gun laws, ranking 9th in the country for sensible gun reforms. But we can’t do this state by state, because illegal, unregistered guns don’t stop at state lines. We need federal gun reforms to ensure universal background checks, stop ghost guns (one of the guns recovered at the Seattle Center shooting was an illegal ghost gun), and prohibit assault weapons and the many ways that weapons can be turned into assault weapons. We need to stop shielding gun manufacturers from liability and we need to require safe storage of guns so they don’t get in the hands of kids and others who shouldn’t have them. These are sensible gun reforms that would help get guns off our streets and keep us safer. Gun violence is not some unavoidable force of nature — it’s a choice that we keep allowing to be made in this country, thanks to gun lobbies and people who forget that the right to live for every single person is paramount.
At the same time, we need to invest in our communities. We need to listen to our young people, who are screaming out for help. We need to help people afford to thrive, not just barely survive. That means ensuring that people can afford health care, including mental health. That young people learn how to cope with the many things they are going through without turning to violence. That we invest in education and training to help people find paths for themselves that offer joy, satisfaction, hope and enough money to thrive. There’s so much we must do to invest in our communities and our futures. That Seattle is a beautiful city. We should be able to gather in our parks and our festivals without fear. And I’m going to keep fighting for solutions until everyone can feel safe here.
Every single time there is a shooting—whether in a crowd or on a street corner that doesn’t even get covered—I believe it IS preventable. We just need to find the political will to do something about it. Thoughts and prayers don’t do it. We have to take real action.
In the days ahead, I’ll be listening to community members and survivors about what safety and healing for our community actually requires, and I’ll be thinking about the families who won’t get their loved ones back after this unimaginable tragedy. Most of all, I’m once again making it clear that I’m going to do everything possible so that we ACT to prevent gun violence in our country.
Meanwhile, I’m sending a message of love to our community here in Seattle and all those across the country that have been rocked by gun violence. Please, take care of each other and ourselves. Let’s use this pain and anger to recommit to the fight to end gun violence once and for all.
With love and resolve,
Pramila Jayapal

# Friend,
---
Just days ago, independent journalist **Nick Shirley** walked into the California State Capitol with a camera and confronted the Democrat lawmakers who are trying to silence him. Most of them scattered. The few who stayed had no real answers. _Why the panic?_ Because California Democrats are fast-tracking **AB 2624** -- already being called the **" Stop Nick Shirley Act."** This bill would make it a **crime** for citizen journalists like Nick to film or post videos of publicly funded facilities -- exactly the kind of on-the-ground investigative work Nick has been doing in California and Minnesota. If this bill passes, Nick's ability to expose taxpayer fraud in government programs could be severely crippled -- or even criminalized -- with fines up to $10,000 and forced content removal. Think about what that means:
---
* Nick's explosive Minnesota daycare fraud investigation that forced Congress to take notice?
* His on-the-ground reporting in California exposing waste and abuse in government programs?
* Future investigations into hospice fraud, voter roll issues, or any other taxpayer-funded facility?

---
**All of it could be criminalized under this new law.** The message from Sacramento Democrats is crystal clear: **" Stop exposing the fraud... ****_or we 'll make sure you can't."_** And the ultimate irony? The same lawmakers who authored and voted to advance this bill watched Nick Shirley walk right up to them in their own Capitol building, microphone in hand, and ask them point-blank why they're trying to criminalize investigative journalism. They had no good answer. **That 's why Lincoln Media Foundation exists -- and why we're asking for your help again today.** LMF is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that **directly funds** independent journalists like Nick Shirley. We cover the real costs of his work -- travel, filming, editing, distribution, and security -- so he can keep investigating stories the mainstream media refuses to touch. Right now, your tax-deductible donation to LMF will go **toward supporting Nick Shirley** and protecting his ability to continue this critical work in the face of this new threat.
