Public education helped Christina become the first person in her family to attend college. She went on to become an environmental engineer, a law professor, and a state legislator. Now, she’s running for Congress to put Iowa first, protect our constitutional freedoms, and make government work for working people again. Peter, The latest news coming out of the Trump administration is a troubling sign of what’s to come. The director of Homeland Security is threatening local election officials with jail time if they don’t cooperate with unnecessary and potentially illegal demands to turn over their voter files. And the Justice Department’s civil rights chief, Harmeet Dhillon — longtime proponent of voter suppression — announced that the agency would be sending election monitors to six states this summer. Her reasoning? “It’s important to make sure that our voting is accurate so that every citizen who votes has their vote counted equally, without being canceled out by somebody who shouldn’t be voting.” Read that last part again: “Somebody who shouldn't be voting.” Considering her own agency concluded that there is no evidence of widespread voter fraud, it seems like Dhillon may really be talking about eligible voters who might support Democrats. It seems it's no accident that many of the jurisdictions they’re targeting with these “election monitors” — places like Maricopa County, AZ, Hennepin County, MN, and Boston — have a deep base of Democratic voters, Black voters, and other people of color. | | Friend,

**This never should have happened.**

A [recent investigation](https://us.list-manage.com/14xwXi2N8Qm?e=77eef70c61&c2id=352d4c3b964128868a59384c192ed166) uncovered that a King County employee oversaw approximately $813,000 in grant payments to businesses connected to five of her relatives. Even worse, concerns had appeared in county records years earlier, but King County did not begin a formal investigation until 2025, following the audit that I had spent years calling for.

**This apparent abuse of public trust is a slap in the face to the hardworking taxpayers of King County.[Help me fight back!](https://us.list-manage.com/Y0xW4q2XFh6?e=77eef70c61&c2id=352d4c3b964128868a59384c192ed166)**

At a time when families are stretching every paycheck, we have an obligation to ensure taxpayer money is protected and public confidence is restored.

**But today, I have great news to announce!**

After leading the Council in passing contracting reforms and helping create a new Inspector General Division, I'm proud to announce that yesterday, the King County Council unanimously passed my legislation to strengthen ethics rules and help ensure this never happens again. **[Read more about this important reform in MyNorthwest here.](https://us.list-manage.com/Exo3nUJTKwi?e=77eef70c61&c2id=352d4c3b964128868a59384c192ed166)**[](https://us.list-manage.com/bHcAz6cH7nY?e=77eef70c61&c2id=352d4c3b964128868a59384c192ed166) **\----------------------
[DONATE NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/_5H9yo3BmjO?e=77eef70c61&c2id=352d4c3b964128868a59384c192ed166)
\----------------------**
Fighting for accountability and passing reforms like this is why the Seattle Times wrote that "_It was Dunn who doggedly pursued answers to lingering questions about the county 's practice of forking over money to contractors for various social services without clear guidance or confidence that the dollars are well spent._"
- **["Councilmember Dunn deserves credit for pushing accountability at King County," Seattle Times](https://us.list-manage.com/AhtDASSsAuv?e=77eef70c61&c2id=352d4c3b964128868a59384c192ed166)** **We 're on a roll, but I'm not done yet. **I need your help to continue demanding accountability, passing more reforms, and ensuring government works for the people who pay for it.

**Would you consider[ making a contribution of $35, $50, $75](https://us.list-manage.com/ljNTKj2BqcN?e=77eef70c61&c2id=352d4c3b964128868a59384c192ed166), to help me continue fighting to protect taxpayers and restore trust in government?** Friend, I couldn't do this without you! Thank you for standing with me to demand accountability and ensure your hard-earned dollars are protected from fraud, waste, and abuse.

Reagan Dunn

body:
All across the country, our progressive movement is building incredible grassroots strength
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2396%2E791427%2ESmNkRC)
Friend — do you feel that?
All across the country, our progressive movement is building incredible grassroots strength and winning real power for our communities in Congress. You can feel the energy in the air.
Chris Rabb in Philadelphia. Adam Hamawy in New Jersey. Melat Kiros in Denver. Brad Lander, Claire Valdez, and Darializa Avila Chevalier in New York. And the list goes on — “the squad” is about to double if not triple in size!
**As we face down the dark days of Trump’s presidency, progressives are responding by electing a historic wave of candidates who are ready to fight Trump, abolish ICE, pass Medicare-for-All, end endless wars, and offer a real alternative to MAGA extremism.**
So, to help make sure we keep this incredible momentum pushing forward, I’m hitting the road this weekend to campaign with two more inspiring candidates who are running at the statewide level: Abdul El-Sayed for Senate in Michigan and Francesca Hong for Wisconsin Governor.
Whether you know these two names or you’re reading them for the first time today, just know this: I am more than confident in Abdul and Francesca’s ability to not only beat MAGA in November, **but to lead with the kind of conviction and moral clarity that has been missing from our politics for so long.**
Friend, I’m extremely grateful to be able to build this movement with you. What we are doing here is not just about one person, one city, one race, or one idea. We are fighting for a better future for _everyone_ in the face of the unlimited resources of the corporate oligarchy and the entrenched establishment.
So, as I prepare to hit the road this weekend, I’m asking for your financial support so I can continue to rally this movement and build the unstoppable progressive machine we’ll need to win:
[**Please, chip in $5, $10, or whatever you can afford today to power our organizing efforts. clean_body: All across the country, our progressive movement is building incredible grassroots strength Friend — do you feel that? All across the country, our progressive movement is building incredible grassroots strength and winning real power for our communities in Congress. You can feel the energy in the air. Chris Rabb in Philadelphia. Adam Hamawy in New Jersey. Melat Kiros in Denver. Brad Lander, Claire Valdez, and Darializa Avila Chevalier in New York. And the list goes on — “the squad” is about to double if not triple in size! As we face down the dark days of Trump’s presidency, progressives are responding by electing a historic wave of candidates who are ready to fight Trump, abolish ICE, pass Medicare-for-All, end endless wars, and offer a real alternative to MAGA extremism. So, to help make sure we keep this incredible momentum pushing forward, I’m hitting the road this weekend to campaign with two more inspiring candidates who are running at the statewide level: Abdul El-Sayed for Senate in Michigan and Francesca Hong for Wisconsin Governor. Whether you know these two names or you’re reading them for the first time today, just know this: I am more than confident in Abdul and Francesca’s ability to not only beat MAGA in November, but to lead with the kind of conviction and moral clarity that has been missing from our politics for so long. Friend, I’m extremely grateful to be able to build this movement with you. What we are doing here is not just about one person, one city, one race, or one idea. We are fighting for a better future for everyone in the face of the unlimited resources of the corporate oligarchy and the entrenched establishment. So, as I prepare to hit the road this weekend, I’m asking for your financial support so I can continue to rally this movement and build the unstoppable progressive machine we’ll need to win: If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your contribution will go through immediately: | | ** | | | | | | | To our neighbors over in Michigan and Wisconsin, I’ll see you soon! Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

---

The sky outside is hazy orange, and my five-year-old son is screaming bloody murder. "Sorry, buddy, we have to stay inside," I say. "It's not safe to breathe out there." I had told him we'd be going to the beach today. Something inside me tears a little as I wonder how many promises he'll see similarly broken in the coming years.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a51079e7-19ef-4485-a89a-13c7bdf3fd78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Far too many parents were forced to have some version of this conversation with their children this month, as smoke from record-breaking wildfires poured across the midwest and north-east. Some of them already had to tell their kids that their [Fourth of July festivities were canceled](https://substack.com/redirect/96d8894a-9283-44e4-bafc-edb9fd12f4b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because of the lethal heatwave that caused numerous [mass casualty](https://substack.com/redirect/db0aecb8-b3e8-4630-a8a4-afb7d863aab1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) events earlier this month.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..KiRDgfikKZ3AJan4uXMnjJbt4yIFYMN3B6-aIlSMuZo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=209038998)
According to scientists, these extreme weather events are not "natural" disasters. A team of researchers already published a [study](https://substack.com/redirect/e719d561-59fa-4098-936f-8321ce275bb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) finding that the Fourth of July heat wave would have been "virtually impossible" but for the climate crisis. Other studies--using methods recently [validated](https://substack.com/redirect/e0805782-2be8-45a9-94b7-3b43e207a93f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the National Academy of Sciences, the country's top scientific advisory body--found that the pollution from [individual Big Oil companies](https://substack.com/redirect/7e5f701d-4c4d-45d4-9b10-7d75688ab009?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) such as ExxonMobil, Chevron, Shell and BP made some past climate-exacerbated heatwaves at least 10,000 times more likely compared with preindustrial levels.
Big Oil's role in these disasters was no accident. Decades ago, these companies were predicting that their fossil fuels would cause, in their own words, "[globally catastrophic](https://substack.com/redirect/bc56698f-3973-4a99-9285-ad31c739dd53?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" climate harms that would create "[more violent weather](https://substack.com/redirect/968153ab-2115-4431-b174-83d2ef4c498a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" and cause "[suffering and death due to thermal extremes](https://substack.com/redirect/afbd64ab-fe22-4591-8f56-8f199db52bad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)". Even as they used this knowledge to [protect their own infrastructure](https://substack.com/redirect/8b265a6e-8a3c-4a13-87bd-1caa21e2c54b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), they orchestrated fraudulent campaigns of [climate denial and deception](https://substack.com/redirect/51a57a2b-8eaf-4da1-8d78-05c7a5417e48?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to lock us into the disasters we are currently experiencing.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0dd6522d-6234-4d44-8448-a7ff88e08952?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Excerpt from an internal 1989 Shell document that modelled the world if we instituted fossil fuel controls (a scenario they labeled SUSTAINABLE WORLD) and if we did not (a scenario they labeled GLOBAL MERCANTILISM).
It's no wonder, then, that climate harms are increasingly being interpreted not just as tragedies but as crimes. "We need Nuremberg trials for Big Oil," wrote one climate advocacy group in a [recent post](https://substack.com/redirect/ccfd3b9c-2589-4dec-a36c-ce52c85c626a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that received tens of thousands of likes--and the sentiment has been echoed by many [others](https://substack.com/redirect/2b668a10-ce52-47b7-9dd5-95addf6ba79f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The desire for an extraordinary tribunal is understandable given the scale of the harm. The Nazis were responsible for approximately 40 million deaths; some [analyses](https://substack.com/redirect/aca11b6b-9048-453b-a50a-837923a936da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) estimate that climate change will cause more than [1 billion](https://substack.com/redirect/e6e4aad8-2cf6-4993-bad1-4bd059d9f229?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) preventable deaths this century.
But we actually don't need any special new legal innovations like the Nuremberg trials to begin to prosecute these climate crimes. In jurisdictions across the country, there are already criminal laws on the books that describe and proscribe Big Oil's conduct in knowingly driving and deceptively covering up the climate crisis--offenses such as reckless endangerment, causing or risking catastrophe, and involuntary manslaughter.
Most states have a [reckless endangerment](https://substack.com/redirect/705a3712-9eba-4ba1-ba26-947230084676?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) offense. These laws criminalize reckless conduct that creates a substantial risk of injuring another person. Recklessness means knowing something is dangerous--e.g., predicting your pollution would cause "more violent weather"--and engaging in that conduct anyway. That's exactly what Big Oil did, and the resulting climate crisis is now creating a substantial risk of injuring people across the country.
Some jurisdictions also criminalize conduct that creates a risk of catastrophe, meaning "[widespread injury or damage](https://substack.com/redirect/ad39a33c-914c-49f5-a581-f618ecf030d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)". [Pennsylvania](https://substack.com/redirect/93f59950-0b42-4b10-af1d-7805d6b7f395?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [New Jersey](https://substack.com/redirect/a78fcf54-e3d9-4365-8e42-0c9e258c12bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) both have these laws on the books, and were two of the states hit hardest by the Fourth of July heatwave, with dozens [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/d276e46f-1f50-47b9-bad9-4e9fdd5b10d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and thousands more [hospitalized](https://substack.com/redirect/41e48328-0728-45e0-94d3-28c0dcd6e9cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Case law shows that these catastrophe laws in particular have been used to prosecute actors for exacerbating a danger by lying about it. In one such case, the operators of a pier in Philadelphia were warned by engineers that the structure was in danger of collapsing. Rather than addressing the problem, they covered it up. When the pier collapsed, the operators were charged with risking catastrophe, and the Pennsylvania supreme court agreed, [writing](https://substack.com/redirect/0ff9a25b-fde0-49b9-a78d-7932df261ce7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): "After having been made specifically aware of the imminent danger that the pier posed to human life, [they] took affirmative measures to keep that knowledge to themselves and took affirmative steps that exposed others to the risk." Swap out the word "pier" for "climate change" and that ruling applies perfectly to Big Oil.
Finally, there's involuntary manslaughter--the crime of recklessly causing (or, in many states, substantially contributing to) the death of another person. Clearly, climate-caused deaths are accelerating--a recent [analysis](https://substack.com/redirect/977d8934-4875-419c-95e0-8543a33ee19e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) found that extreme heat from climate change may have caused more than 20,000 deaths in Europe last month alone. Already, there are victims and survivors who are connecting the dots to Big Oil. Earlier this month, a Washington state court ruled that a lawsuit against the fossil fuel industry for the [wrongful death](https://substack.com/redirect/6932a2e1-4eee-40a9-8d14-f96c04b66d0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the plaintiff's mother in a climate-induced heatwave will proceed toward discovery and trial. Prosecutors could follow suit and begin charging Big Oil companies in relation to the climate disasters that are, in some instances, taking the lives of [more](https://substack.com/redirect/23e87ff1-9508-40e6-aa61-0b8b43284114?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of their constituents than are being lost to traditional homicides.
Of course, the scale of Big Oil's climate liability will only grow in the coming years--this is, after all, not just the hottest summer of our lives, but the coolest summer for the rest of our lives. Someday, we can hope that the corporate actors responsible for such breathtaking havoc will face a made-to-fit tribunal that can fully address the ways they have condemned my five-year-old and countless children like him to a dangerous future. But we don't need to wait.
Climate victims deserve justice now, and the officials responsible for pursuing that justice have all the laws they need to begin prosecuting Big Oil today. So next time you hear a climate disaster described as a crime, remember that this isn't just rhetoric. These really are crimes. It's time we treated them that way.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ec272b04-aa77-4f9d-a0f0-5d8f1d70ac3e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

body:
A quick note before tonight

**Hey Friend,**

**_I wanted to send you a[quick update](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=86f96a4b89204c25bcb0fa6e8161b237&_e=OZaC_ObPdH0YRkXZ_a3kBJDzZZTBzNjfxeq8RRX51ejPUFqXVzNZVRVf-XBv4UnNdRwd81CavN-oaGxFK3xdD_BorU6_7MOjtaVeyklF7oNOm_nqI7tOhyNR8OwG82tUmrVe6JaLkViI-oa_k7GQ0Y-fci_12QQzsU2V0bQbttEj5jRKnl2IXZ95VS3FRGGyIbUIeO6X5M5gxwncQszDBQk__gbE7zGj62xy0V9k6Hs5IwZdja90eEFzDMOsvDU1VUrJwuQozKv2-8jnQacY7NWD2uTHU8mpX18T70W3h1ZbxNLnlLODybxzFUaPgf22K5i3EQrKQxAX465bAZEuWMtCKSYtecFh_tBzkZMmR2uW2RSRwqAe64debwj9yrNzq9j0HiuRpEP25JHRH8oeBSgIGq_sNPuecR4Xqvkk4Uf3bKHQXJEXNDsD-Hc5bDYbkGYZgqTjlXjYi8cF0jUC5couyhDE9_B6eiKJa_Y1QZoLmckAfZjpp9vnYaAmJACJEiElWt5bluZfrwdNZkNbSTXXpa6hZR9_DWmuh304lRw%3D) before our end-of-month deadline comes up._**

We are making strong progress, and I am grateful for the support that has gotten us this far. At the same time, we are still just short of where we need to be to finish out this month with confidence.

Moments like this may not seem significant on the surface, but they shape what comes next.

**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hey friends,
_**A must-read this morning:**_ Anthony Fauci sat before the Senate this morning and repeatedly invoked the Fifth Amendment rather than answer for the government's COVID-19 response — including a direct request to apologize to Americans who say his policies cost them their jobs, their businesses, and their freedom. Read RMV's detailed timeline & how his silence connects back to Colorado's own pandemic story, chronicled in **[RMV's COvid Chronicles series](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**.

Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
Here's a summary of today's top stories:
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** Denver Council sent a [20-year, $180M/year Xcel franchise deal](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to November's ballot. Schools got [$24M more for the voter-approved free meals program](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), which remains "underfunded" since 2022. The governor's race is now three-way after [Greg Lopez qualified as an independent](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), amid rising unaffiliated registration. A former Jeffco security guard, 67, faces [30+ child sex crime charges](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) tied to a decade-long abuse case. And YDSA has grown to 150+ chapters nationally, [including four in Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with one CU Boulder instructor admitting he built a required course to recruit for the campus chapter.
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** Trump asked the Supreme Court to [revive his mail-in voting order](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after a judge blocked it in 23 states; Democratic states argue elections are a state power. Separately, Rep. Jason Smith subpoenaed three nonprofits tied to Shanghai-based donor Neville Roy Singham over [funds allegedly linked to the CCP](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** Joondeph argues Americans lost trust when questions went unanswered, pointing to Rasmussen polling that found [nearly half believe COVID vaccines likely caused unexplained deaths](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Gaines finds activist group GreenLatinos' tax filings show [heavy salary spending and a well-paid CEO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) relative to grants. Hancock argues racial-collectivist ideology, privilege or guilt framed, still [judges people by ancestry over character.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
This is your Mountain Minute for Wednesday, July 29, 2026.
– Team RMV

Wednesday’s hearing renewed attention to school closures, distancing rules, business restrictions, government data and the origins of COVID-19.
After his opening statement, Fauci repeatedly invoked the Fifth Amendment instead of answering senators’ questions. But for RMV readers, it served as a reminder of a record that already exists. Over 11 installments published last year, the _**[COvid Chronicles](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_ documented how pandemic policies reshaped life across Colorado.
Among the stories documented in the series was a Brighton father who was handcuffed and briefly detained after playing T-ball with his wife and young daughter in a park. **[What DSA teaches college students, and the environment it operates in](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_A structured socialist recruitment pipeline runs through American college campuses — and in Colorado, it reached a required university course._
* **A built-out campus operation:** Young Democratic Socialists of America (YDSA), DSA's youth arm, has grown from a dozen chapters in 2016 to over 150 today, runs its own published curriculum — including a "Socialist Night School Manual" and "School of Socialism Syllabus" — and automatically enrolls members into DSA itself.
* **From classroom to career pipeline:** YDSA members voted in 2020 to build a "Rank-and-File pipeline" steering graduates toward jobs in education, healthcare, and logistics, with DSA's own teachers' pamphlet arguing socialists should specifically become teachers for the "political, economic, and social potential" the profession offers.
* **A required Colorado course built to recruit:** A CU Boulder instructor and DSA-caucus member built a section of a mandatory writing course around socialist organizing themes, later writing he created it "to propagandize" students and give his campus YDSA chapter "college credit for organizing" — the university confirmed he's no longer employed there after RMV's reporting.

**[Colorado’s newest coal plant hasn’t run since August 2025. A national report suggests why.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | JULY 27**
_Xcel Energy’s Comanche 3 power plant in Pueblo went offline on August 12, 2025, after elevated vibrations damaged the turbine. Nearly a year later, it still hasn’t produced a single watt._
**[The candidates you never got to vote for](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY C. J. GARBO | COMMENTARY | JULY 27** _Over the last three years prior to my leaving Colorado, a number of elected officials and party activists asked me to run for office. The list is not short. Castle Rock Town Council. Douglas County Commissioner. State House. State Senate. More than once, State Party Chair. A few of those conversations were casual. Several were serious, with people offering to open doors, raise money, and put their own names behind mine._
**[The Thriftiness Weapon: A-Tisket A-Tasket](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | JULY 26** _A-tisket, a-tasket, a green and yellow basket. I wrote a letter to my love, and on the way I dropped it. Like most children, I never gave much thought to those words. I imagined a little girl happily skipping along with her colorful basket until, somewhere along the road, she accidentally dropped it. It wasn’t until years later that I realized the basket wasn’t really the tragedy. Baskets are replaceable. The real loss was what she was carrying. She dropped the letter to her love._

Friends,With 97 days until Election Day, I want to take a moment to thank every volunteer who came out to our 100 Days to Victory door launch this past weekend. Your energy, dedication, and commitment to our campaign are what make this grassroots movement so special.**While my opponent is bringing his establishment Democratic Party bosses to campaign for him, we're building a true grassroots campaign powered by the people of the Greater Lehigh Valley. It's your hard work—knocking on doors, making phone calls, and talking with neighbors—that will make the difference on Election Day.** Sharing our message of **Delivering for Our Community** as we knock on doors and head into the final stretch of this campaign is incredibly fulfilling – because it tells people what we’ve done for them!Since entering Congress, I have been proud to deliver pragmatic results for the people of the Greater Lehigh Valley. Our office has resolved more than **10,000 constituent service cases** , helping families navigate issues with federal agencies and recover more than **$18.6 million** in taxpayer funds that had been tied up in agencies like the IRS and VA. We've also helped secure more than **$60 million** for important projects across our community and responded to more than **250,000 constituent messages**.I've also fought for tax relief for every American with an increased standard deduction, and we built on that with **No Tax on Tips, No Tax on Overtime, and No Tax on Social Security for 88% of seniors**. I helped working families by leading the successful effort to expand the Child Tax Credit. And I kept my promise to never cut Social Security or Medicare. I'm also working every day to make Congress accountable to people, not special interests by co-sponsoring legislation to ban congressional stock trading, supporting term limits, and standing up to stop special treatment for powerful pesticide companies who want to be held harmless if their products cause cancer. None of these accomplishments would have been possible without your support. Together, we've built a campaign focused on results, not rhetoric. Over these final 100 days, let's continue talking to our neighbors, knocking on doors, making phone calls, and sharing our record of delivering for the people of the Greater Lehigh Valley.With your continued support, we'll keep **Delivering for Our Community** —and together, we'll win on Election Day.

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | | Friends,With 97 days until Election Day, I want to take a moment to thank every volunteer who came out to our 100 Days to Victory door launch this past weekend. Your energy, dedication, and commitment to our campaign are what make this grassroots movement so special.While my opponent is bringing his establishment Democratic Party bosses to campaign for him, we're building a true grassroots campaign powered by the people of the Greater Lehigh Valley. It's your hard work—knocking on doors, making phone calls, and talking with neighbors—that will make the difference on Election Day. Sharing our message of Delivering for Our Community as we knock on doors and head into the final stretch of this campaign is incredibly fulfilling – because it tells people what we’ve done for them!Since entering Congress, I have been proud to deliver pragmatic results for the people of the Greater Lehigh Valley. Our office has resolved more than 10,000 constituent service cases , helping families navigate issues with federal agencies and recover more than $18.6 million in taxpayer funds that had been tied up in agencies like the IRS and VA. We've also helped secure more than $60 million for important projects across our community and responded to more than 250,000 constituent messages.I've also fought for tax relief for every American with an increased standard deduction, and we built on that with No Tax on Tips, No Tax on Overtime, and No Tax on Social Security for 88% of seniors. I helped working families by leading the successful effort to expand the Child Tax Credit. And I kept my promise to never cut Social Security or Medicare. I'm also working every day to make Congress accountable to people, not special interests by co-sponsoring legislation to ban congressional stock trading, supporting term limits, and standing up to stop special treatment for powerful pesticide companies who want to be held harmless if their products cause cancer. None of these accomplishments would have been possible without your support. Together, we've built a campaign focused on results, not rhetoric. # MEDIA ADVISORY

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
July 29, 2026

**CONTACT**
Todd Cheewing
Todd@Ascent-Strategic.com **REMINDER: LILY TANG WILLIAMS TO HOST _ASK ME ANYTHING_ TOWN HALL IN WINDHAM TOMORROW EVENING** WEARE, N.H. — Republican congressional candidate Lily Tang Williams is reminding members of the media that she will host the first event in her new "Ask Me Anything" Town Hall Series tomorrow evening in Windham.
The town hall is open to the public and the media, offering Granite Staters an opportunity to ask questions directly, share their concerns, and engage in an open conversation about the issues impacting New Hampshire and the nation.
While many politicians carefully script their appearances and limit public interaction, Lily Tang Williams is inviting voters to ask any question on any topic. The event reflects her commitment to accessibility, transparency, and accountability throughout the campaign.
**EVENT DETAILS**
What: _Ask Me Anything_ Town Hall with Lily Tang Williams When: Thursday, July 30, 2026 Time: 6:00 PM – 7:30 PM (Doors Open at 5:30 PM) Where: A.J. Letizio Enterprise Center 55 Enterprise Drive Windham, NH 03087 _**Complimentary appetizers and refreshments will be provided.**_ **Note:** Media planning to attend are encouraged to RSVP by contacting the campaign, though RSVP is not required.

**About Lily Tang Williams**
Born in China just before Mao’s Cultural Revolution to working-class parents, Lily Tang Williams immigrated to the United States with nothing and built a life as an entrepreneur, educator, and community leader in Weare, NH. A living embodiment of the American Dream, she brings a uniquely powerful perspective to the fight for freedom and limited government.

In 2024, Williams won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against current incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in more than a decade to flipping NH-02. She is back and running stronger than ever in 2026.

In 2024, Williams won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against current incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in more than a decade to flipping NH-02. I’ll be honest: I’ve always been a glass-half-full kind of person.

In times like these, I know it’s difficult to stay optimistic — or even
hopeful — about our country’s future. But I am. And I hope you are too.

But Derek, I want
to be clear: That optimism doesn’t make me naive. I know the stakes are
high. I know nothing is set in stone. And I know that a far-right Governor
could reverse all the progress we’ve made together.

chip in $10 right away to
help us reach our End-of-Month fundraising goal, double down on our voter
outreach programs, and keep the far-right out of power here in the most
competitive state in the country?

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/5079?t=1002&akid=159%2E245147%2EF25tdE ]Donate

As we approach November, I’m feeling optimistic,
Derek. But that doesn’t mean we
can sit back and watch from the sidelines. The far-right has all the same
information we have — and we know they won’t take their ball and go home.

We have to stay ready. We have to stay vigilant. We have to stay prepared.
And Derek, we
can only do that with your help.

Thank you,

Josh

subject: ACTION: Tell the U.S. Senate No Recess Until They Pass The SAVE America Act!
body:
New polling shows the American people want Congress to enact the SAVE America Act before the 2026 midterms
[](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org/1/0100019fb034664d-5d30631b-ba73-4e99-b15c-ac4d4db84191-000000/gya9RUKcC5FCGlsjnqYXjEyLnQntchiz_mnUzCNhVGY=452)Patriot–The SAVE America Act has passed the U.S. House of Representatives for the fourth time.House Republicans have done their job. Now it's time for the U.S. Senate to do theirs.The American people agree: the time is now to secure our elections![_**New polling conducted for Tea Party Patriots Action**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Fjuly-2026-save-america-act-poll%2F/1/0100019fb034664d-5d30631b-ba73-4e99-b15c-ac4d4db84191-000000/K8lf7A0pgbuSGfcTTdpgUCHRHYxSFqiU2A6nWIFOEvA=452) shows that the overwhelming majority of American voters – including a strong majority of Democrats – support proof of U.S. citizenship in order to register to vote and showing voter ID when casting a ballot.[VIEW POLL RESULTS](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Fjuly-2026-save-america-act-poll%2F/2/0100019fb034664d-5d30631b-ba73-4e99-b15c-ac4d4db84191-000000/xxVw38vDtCGGQnIyYD-aAQKuaAleLHAQIGaBIrupgAM=452)The message to the Senate is clear: stop delaying, listen to the voters, and pass the SAVE America Act.The Senate must not adjourn for the August recess until it passes the House versions of the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) and the 2027 Homeland Security funding bill containing the SAVE America Act.Passing these bills is the fastest path to getting the SAVE America Act to President Trump's desk and strengthen election integrity before the 2026 midterm elections.[PASS THE SAVE AMERICA ACT](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Fsave-america-act%2F/1/0100019fb034664d-5d30631b-ba73-4e99-b15c-ac4d4db84191-000000/DhucuYz2KetTJ3GHzrJfpxNvBwhAqtbaSdF-eioRoa8=452)We need you to step up once again.[_**Call your U.S. Senators today**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Fsave-america-act%2F/2/0100019fb034664d-5d30631b-ba73-4e99-b15c-ac4d4db84191-000000/L8fC8d5-_EP5Onpyq6mugqbn5eqYsqsbIRksLEH3Y7I=452) and tell them: Don't leave Washington for the August recess until you've passed the SAVE America Act.Urge them to vote YES on the House-passed NDAA and YES on the House Homeland Security funding bill so the SAVE America Act can become law.There is still time to secure the midterm elections.The Senate should stay in session until the job is done.In liberty,Jenny Beth body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
LAST CALL: Sign the pledge to support a brighter future for working Texans
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hear%20America.png]
These last few weeks, TOP has teamed up with our friends at the Organizing Revival Network to promote the Willing to Fight Pledge [https://toptx.us/orn] -- a commitment to a vision and future where ALL Texans have the ability to grow and thrive.
We're only a few days from our end-of-June deadline. Can you sign the pledge today to help us reach our completed pledge goal? [https://toptx.us/orn]
It only takes a minute and your feedback provides our groups with a look at what issues matter most to you and your family.
👉🏾 Take the pledge now! [https://toptx.us/orn]
Celebrating our communities and building fellowship this Juneteenth
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/01%202026%20Juneteenth.jpg]
TOP staff and members celebrated Juneteenth alongside community partners at events across Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio this past week. Through that celebration we honor the ancestors we stand on the shoulders of, and recommit to working tirelessly toward a future where race and class are no longer barriers to justice and opportunity in our country.
Juneteenth serves as a renewed call to unite against racial and economic injustice, so that we can chart a path toward a stronger Texas and nation that uplifts and empowers every Black person, regardless of their background or economic status. This is why we organize. This is why we are stronger together.
Taking time this summer to refuel for the second half of 2026
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20summer%202026%20out.jpg]
TOP offices will be closed Saturday, June 27 - Sunday, July 5, as we take time to rest, rejuvenate, and prepare for a busy rest of 2026 filled with organizing and getting out the vote! You can still keep in touch with us online, though. Give us a follow on the following platforms:
Facebook [https://www.facebook.com/texasorganizingproject/]
Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/texasorganizingproject]
BlackTOP Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/blacktoptexas]
TikTok [https://www.tiktok.com/@organizetexas]
X (Twitter) [https://x.com/TXOrgProject]
Bluesky [https://bsky.app/profile/txorgproject.bsky.social]
TOP Tip: Get the most out of your vacation phone pics
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Summer%202026%20vacation%20photo%20tips.jpg]
Taking quality phone pics can be easier said than done! Whether you're traveling abroad, across the state, or just within your community this summer, utilize these easy tips [https://www.techadvisor.com/article/3170604/8-professional-tips-for-better-smartphone-photos.html] on how to get the most out of your smartphone photos this summer to capture those special moments.

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hear%20America.png]
En las últimas semanas, TOP se ha unido a nuestros amigos de Organizing Revival Network para promover el compromiso "Willing to Fight" [https://toptx.us/orn] (Dispuestos a Luchar): un compromiso con una visión y un futuro en los que TODOS los tejanos tengan la oportunidad de crecer y prosperar.
Estamos a pocos días de nuestra fecha límite de finales de junio. ¿Podrías firmar el compromiso hoy mismo para ayudarnos a alcanzar nuestra meta? [https://toptx.us/orn]
Solo te llevará un minuto, y tu opinión nos permitirá saber qué temas son los más importantes para ti y tu familia.
👉🏾 ¡Firma el compromiso ahora! [https://toptx.us/orn]
Celebrando a nuestras comunidades y fortaleciendo la camaradería en este Juneteenth
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/01%202026%20Juneteenth.jpg]
La semana pasada, el personal y los miembros de TOP celebraron Juneteenth junto a aliados comunitarios en eventos realizados en Houston, Dallas y San Antonio. A través de esta celebración, honramos a los ancestros sobre cuyos hombros nos apoyamos y reafirmamos nuestro compromiso de trabajar incansablemente por un futuro en el que la raza y la clase social ya no sean barreras para la justicia y las oportunidades en nuestro país.
Juneteenth representa un llamado renovado a unirnos contra la injusticia racial y económica, para así trazar el camino hacia un Texas y una nación más fuertes que impulsen y empoderen a cada persona afrodescendiente, independientemente de sus antecedentes o situación económica. Por esto nos organizamos. Por esto somos más fuertes unidos.
Dedicar tiempo este verano a recargar energías para la segunda mitad de 2026
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20Spanish%20summer%202026%20out.jpg]
Las oficinas de TOP permanecerán cerradas desde el sábado 27 de junio hasta el domingo 5 de julio ; aprovecharemos este tiempo para descansar, renovar energías y prepararnos para el resto del año 2026, ¡lleno de actividades de organización y movilización del voto! body:

Peter, here’s the situation: **We have two days left until our end-of-month deadline.[If that is all you need to hear, will you make a donation to our campaign today?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260729-2.7ULeMo&refcode=em-20260729-2&t=2&akid=1678%2E1086043%2Eh4GidI)** If not, keep reading.
Every deadline in this race counts because re-election is _not_ guaranteed. Two of the last four governors before me were Republicans. And now, my MAGA opponent is gearing up to spend whatever he can to defeat our re-election campaign.
**[Can you chip in any amount before our July 31st deadline?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260729-2.7ULeMo&refcode=em-20260729-2&t=3&akid=1678%2E1086043%2Eh4GidI)**

We can’t let that happen.

Elevate,

Peter,

_I’m very upset, and I need to get something off my chest._

Breaking away from tyranny in 1776, Patriots venturing across the continent and settling the land (including my home state of California), ending the evil practice of slavery, sailing back across the ocean to defeat fascist and communist powers in two World Wars, putting a man on the moon and winning the space race, and even uniting as a country against terrorists after 9/11.

**After all of that, you would think Americans would be proud. You would think there is NO QUESTION that our Democratic Republic is unrivaled in the world.**

_But Democrats don’t see it that way._

The Radical Left has become so disillusioned, so corrupt, and so hateful towards President Trump that they’re openly inviting Socialism and Communism into America.
